59 // RHI resources should only be destructed via the deletion queue,
60 // so this is protected to prevent others from 'delete'ing these directly.

64 // Separate function to avoid force inlining this everywhere. Helps both for code size and performance.

72public:
73 inline uint32 AddRef() const
74 {
75 int32 NewValue = AtomicFlags.AddRef(std::memory_order_acquire);
76 checkSlow(NewValue > 0);
77 return uint32(NewValue);
78 }
79
80 inline uint32 Release() const
81 {
82 int32 NewValue = AtomicFlags.Release(std::memory_order_release);
83 check(NewValue >= 0);
84
85 if (NewValue == 0)
86 {
87 MarkForDelete();
88 }
89 checkSlow(NewValue >= 0);
90 return uint32(NewValue);
91 }
92
93 inline uint32 GetRefCount() const
94 {
95 int32 CurrentValue = AtomicFlags.GetNumRefs(std::memory_order_relaxed);
96 checkSlow(CurrentValue >= 0);
97 return uint32(CurrentValue);
98 }
99
100 bool IsValid() const
101 {
102 return AtomicFlags.IsValid(std::memory_order_relaxed);
103 }
104
105 void DisableLifetimeExtension()
106 {
107 ensureMsgf(IsValid(), TEXT("Resource is already marked for deletion. This call is a no-op. DisableLifetimeExtension must be called while still holding a live reference."));
108 bAllowExtendLifetime = false;
109 }

140private:
141 class FAtomicFlags
142 {
143 static constexpr uint32 MarkedForDeleteBit = 1 << 30;
144 static constexpr uint32 DeletingBit = 1 << 31;
145 static constexpr uint32 NumRefsMask = ~(MarkedForDeleteBit | DeletingBit);
146
147 std::atomic_uint Packed = { 0 };
148
149 public:
150 int32 AddRef(std::memory_order MemoryOrder)
151 {
152 uint32 OldPacked = Packed.fetch_add(1, MemoryOrder);
153 checkf((OldPacked & DeletingBit) == 0, TEXT("Resource is being deleted."));
154 int32 NumRefs = (OldPacked & NumRefsMask) + 1;
155 checkf(NumRefs < NumRefsMask, TEXT("Reference count has overflowed."));
156 return NumRefs;
157 }
158
159 int32 Release(std::memory_order MemoryOrder)
160 {
161 uint32 OldPacked = Packed.fetch_sub(1, MemoryOrder);
162 checkf((OldPacked & DeletingBit) == 0, TEXT("Resource is being deleted."));
163 int32 NumRefs = (OldPacked & NumRefsMask) - 1;
164 checkf(NumRefs >= 0, TEXT("Reference count has underflowed."));
165 return NumRefs;
166 }
167
168 bool MarkForDelete(std::memory_order MemoryOrder)
169 {
170 uint32 OldPacked = Packed.fetch_or(MarkedForDeleteBit, MemoryOrder);
171 check((OldPacked & DeletingBit) == 0);
172 return (OldPacked & MarkedForDeleteBit) != 0;
173 }
174
175 bool UnmarkForDelete(std::memory_order MemoryOrder)
176 {
177 uint32 OldPacked = Packed.fetch_xor(MarkedForDeleteBit, MemoryOrder);
178 check((OldPacked & DeletingBit) == 0);
179 bool OldMarkedForDelete = (OldPacked & MarkedForDeleteBit) != 0;
180 check(OldMarkedForDelete == true);
181 return OldMarkedForDelete;
182 }
183
184 bool Deleting()
185 {
186 uint32 LocalPacked = Packed.load(std::memory_order_acquire);
187 check((LocalPacked & MarkedForDeleteBit) != 0);
188 check((LocalPacked & DeletingBit) == 0);
189 uint32 NumRefs = LocalPacked & NumRefsMask;
190
191 if (NumRefs == 0) // caches can bring dead objects back to life
192 {
193#if DO_CHECK
194 Packed.fetch_or(DeletingBit, std::memory_order_acquire);
195#endif
196 return true;
197 }
198 else
199 {
200 UnmarkForDelete(std::memory_order_release);
201 return false;
202 }
203 }
204
205 bool IsValid(std::memory_order MemoryOrder)
206 {
207 uint32 LocalPacked = Packed.load(MemoryOrder);
208 return (LocalPacked & MarkedForDeleteBit) == 0 && (LocalPacked & NumRefsMask) != 0;
209 }
210
211 bool IsMarkedForDelete(std::memory_order MemoryOrder)
212 {
213 return (Packed.load(MemoryOrder) & MarkedForDeleteBit) != 0;
214 }
215
216 int32 GetNumRefs(std::memory_order MemoryOrder)
217 {
218 return Packed.load(MemoryOrder) & NumRefsMask;
219 }
220 };
221 mutable FAtomicFlags AtomicFlags;
222
223 const ERHIResourceType ResourceType;
224 uint8 bCommitted : 1;
225 uint8 bAllowExtendLifetime : 1;
226#if RHI_ENABLE_RESOURCE_INFO
227 uint8 bBeingTracked : 1;
228 FName OwnerName;
229#endif
230
231#if DO_CHECK
232 static thread_local FRHIResource const* CurrentlyDeleting;
233#endif
234
235 friend FRHICommandListImmediate;
236};

238enum class EClearBinding
239{
240 ENoneBound, //no clear color associated with this target. Target will not do hardware clears on most platforms
241 EColorBound, //target has a clear color bound. Clears will use the bound color, and do hardware clears.
242 EDepthStencilBound, //target has a depthstencil value bound. Clears will use the bound values and do hardware clears.
243};

245struct FClearValueBinding
246{
247 struct DSVAlue
248 {
249 float Depth;
250 uint32 Stencil;
251 };
252
253 FClearValueBinding()
254 : ColorBinding(EClearBinding::EColorBound)
255 {
256 Value.Color[0] = 0.0f;
257 Value.Color[1] = 0.0f;
258 Value.Color[2] = 0.0f;
259 Value.Color[3] = 0.0f;
260 }
261
262 FClearValueBinding(EClearBinding NoBinding)
263 : ColorBinding(NoBinding)
264 {
265 check(ColorBinding == EClearBinding::ENoneBound);
266
267 Value.Color[0] = 0.0f;
268 Value.Color[1] = 0.0f;
269 Value.Color[2] = 0.0f;
270 Value.Color[3] = 0.0f;
271
272 Value.DSValue.Depth = 0.0f;
273 Value.DSValue.Stencil = 0;
274 }
275
276 explicit FClearValueBinding(const FLinearColor& InClearColor)
277 : ColorBinding(EClearBinding::EColorBound)
278 {
279 Value.Color[0] = InClearColor.R;
280 Value.Color[1] = InClearColor.G;
281 Value.Color[2] = InClearColor.B;
282 Value.Color[3] = InClearColor.A;
283 }
284
285 explicit FClearValueBinding(float DepthClearValue, uint32 StencilClearValue = 0)
286 : ColorBinding(EClearBinding::EDepthStencilBound)
287 {
288 Value.DSValue.Depth = DepthClearValue;
289 Value.DSValue.Stencil = StencilClearValue;
290 }
291
292 FLinearColor GetClearColor() const
293 {
294 ensure(ColorBinding == EClearBinding::EColorBound);
295 return FLinearColor(Value.Color[0], Value.Color[1], Value.Color[2], Value.Color[3]);
296 }
297
298 void GetDepthStencil(float& OutDepth, uint32& OutStencil) const
299 {
300 ensure(ColorBinding == EClearBinding::EDepthStencilBound);
301 OutDepth = Value.DSValue.Depth;
302 OutStencil = Value.DSValue.Stencil;
303 }
304
305 bool operator==(const FClearValueBinding& Other) const
306 {
307 if (ColorBinding == Other.ColorBinding)
308 {
309 if (ColorBinding == EClearBinding::EColorBound)
310 {
311 return
312 Value.Color[0] == Other.Value.Color[0] &&
313 Value.Color[1] == Other.Value.Color[1] &&
314 Value.Color[2] == Other.Value.Color[2] &&
315 Value.Color[3] == Other.Value.Color[3];
316
317 }
318 if (ColorBinding == EClearBinding::EDepthStencilBound)
319 {
320 return
321 Value.DSValue.Depth == Other.Value.DSValue.Depth &&
322 Value.DSValue.Stencil == Other.Value.DSValue.Stencil;
323 }
324 return true;
325 }
326 return false;
327 }
328
329 friend inline uint32 GetTypeHash(FClearValueBinding const& Binding)
330 {
331 uint32 Hash = GetTypeHash(Binding.ColorBinding);
332
333 if (Binding.ColorBinding == EClearBinding::EColorBound)
334 {
335 Hash = HashCombine(Hash, GetTypeHash(Binding.Value.Color[0]));
336 Hash = HashCombine(Hash, GetTypeHash(Binding.Value.Color[1]));
337 Hash = HashCombine(Hash, GetTypeHash(Binding.Value.Color[2]));
338 Hash = HashCombine(Hash, GetTypeHash(Binding.Value.Color[3]));
339 }
340 else if (Binding.ColorBinding == EClearBinding::EDepthStencilBound)
341 {
342 Hash = HashCombine(Hash, GetTypeHash(Binding.Value.DSValue.Depth ));
343 Hash = HashCombine(Hash, GetTypeHash(Binding.Value.DSValue.Stencil));
344 }
345
346 return Hash;
347 }
348
349 EClearBinding ColorBinding;
350
351 union ClearValueType
352 {
353 float Color[4];
354 DSVAlue DSValue;
355 } Value;
356
357 // common clear values

371class FExclusiveDepthStencil
372{
373public:
374 enum Type
375 {
376 // don't use those directly, use the combined versions below
377 // 4 bits are used for depth and 4 for stencil to make the hex value readable and non overlapping
378 DepthNop = 0x00,
379 DepthRead = 0x01,
380 DepthWrite = 0x02,
381 DepthMask = 0x0f,
382 StencilNop = 0x00,
383 StencilRead = 0x10,
384 StencilWrite = 0x20,
385 StencilMask = 0xf0,
386
387 // use those:
388 DepthNop_StencilNop = DepthNop + StencilNop,
389 DepthRead_StencilNop = DepthRead + StencilNop,
390 DepthWrite_StencilNop = DepthWrite + StencilNop,
391 DepthNop_StencilRead = DepthNop + StencilRead,
392 DepthRead_StencilRead = DepthRead + StencilRead,
393 DepthWrite_StencilRead = DepthWrite + StencilRead,
394 DepthNop_StencilWrite = DepthNop + StencilWrite,
395 DepthRead_StencilWrite = DepthRead + StencilWrite,
396 DepthWrite_StencilWrite = DepthWrite + StencilWrite,
397 };
398
399private:
400 Type Value;
401
402public:
403 // constructor
404 FExclusiveDepthStencil(Type InValue = DepthNop_StencilNop)
405 : Value(InValue)
406 {
407 }
408
409 inline bool IsUsingDepthStencil() const
410 {
411 return Value != DepthNop_StencilNop;
412 }
413 inline bool IsUsingDepth() const
414 {
415 return (ExtractDepth() != DepthNop);
416 }
417 inline bool IsUsingStencil() const
418 {
419 return (ExtractStencil() != StencilNop);
420 }
421 inline bool IsDepthWrite() const
422 {
423 return ExtractDepth() == DepthWrite;
424 }
425 inline bool IsDepthRead() const
426 {
427 return ExtractDepth() == DepthRead;
428 }
429 inline bool IsStencilWrite() const
430 {
431 return ExtractStencil() == StencilWrite;
432 }
433 inline bool IsStencilRead() const
434 {
435 return ExtractStencil() == StencilRead;
436 }
437
438 inline bool IsAnyWrite() const
439 {
440 return IsDepthWrite() || IsStencilWrite();
441 }
442
443 inline void SetDepthWrite()
444 {
445 Value = (Type)(ExtractStencil() | DepthWrite);
446 }
447 inline void SetStencilWrite()
448 {
449 Value = (Type)(ExtractDepth() | StencilWrite);
450 }
451 inline void SetDepthStencilWrite(bool bDepth, bool bStencil)
452 {
453 Value = DepthNop_StencilNop;
454
455 if (bDepth)
456 {
457 SetDepthWrite();
458 }
459 if (bStencil)
460 {
461 SetStencilWrite();
462 }
463 }
464 bool operator==(const FExclusiveDepthStencil& rhs) const
465 {
466 return Value == rhs.Value;
467 }
468
469 bool operator != (const FExclusiveDepthStencil& RHS) const
470 {
471 return Value != RHS.Value;
472 }
473
474 inline bool IsValid(FExclusiveDepthStencil& Current) const
475 {
476 Type Depth = ExtractDepth();
477
478 if (Depth != DepthNop && Depth != Current.ExtractDepth())
479 {
480 return false;
481 }
482
483 Type Stencil = ExtractStencil();
484
485 if (Stencil != StencilNop && Stencil != Current.ExtractStencil())
486 {
487 return false;
488 }
489
490 return true;
491 }
492
493 inline void GetAccess(ERHIAccess& DepthAccess, ERHIAccess& StencilAccess) const
494 {
495 DepthAccess = ERHIAccess::None;
496
497 // SRV access is allowed whilst a depth stencil target is "readable".
498 constexpr ERHIAccess DSVReadOnlyMask =
499 ERHIAccess::DSVRead;
500
501 // If write access is required, only the depth block can access the resource.
502 constexpr ERHIAccess DSVReadWriteMask =
503 ERHIAccess::DSVRead |
504 ERHIAccess::DSVWrite;
505
506 if (IsUsingDepth())
507 {
508 DepthAccess = IsDepthWrite() ? DSVReadWriteMask : DSVReadOnlyMask;
509 }
510
511 StencilAccess = ERHIAccess::None;
512
513 if (IsUsingStencil())
514 {
515 StencilAccess = IsStencilWrite() ? DSVReadWriteMask : DSVReadOnlyMask;
516 }
517 }
518
519 template <typename TFunction>
520 inline void EnumerateSubresources(TFunction Function) const
521 {
522 if (!IsUsingDepthStencil())
523 {
524 return;
525 }
526
527 ERHIAccess DepthAccess = ERHIAccess::None;
528 ERHIAccess StencilAccess = ERHIAccess::None;
529 GetAccess(DepthAccess, StencilAccess);
530
531 // Same depth / stencil state; single subresource.
532 if (DepthAccess == StencilAccess)
533 {
534 Function(DepthAccess, FRHITransitionInfo::kAllSubresources);
535 }
536 // Separate subresources for depth / stencil.
537 else
538 {
539 if (DepthAccess != ERHIAccess::None)
540 {
541 Function(DepthAccess, FRHITransitionInfo::kDepthPlaneSlice);
542 }
543 if (StencilAccess != ERHIAccess::None)
544 {
545 Function(StencilAccess, FRHITransitionInfo::kStencilPlaneSlice);
546 }
547 }
548 }
549
555 inline FExclusiveDepthStencil GetReadableTransition() const
556 {
557 FExclusiveDepthStencil::Type NewDepthState = IsDepthWrite()
558 ? FExclusiveDepthStencil::DepthRead
559 : FExclusiveDepthStencil::DepthNop;
560
561 FExclusiveDepthStencil::Type NewStencilState = IsStencilWrite()
562 ? FExclusiveDepthStencil::StencilRead
563 : FExclusiveDepthStencil::StencilNop;
564
565 return (FExclusiveDepthStencil::Type)(NewDepthState | NewStencilState);
566 }
567
573 inline FExclusiveDepthStencil GetWritableTransition() const
574 {
575 FExclusiveDepthStencil::Type NewDepthState = IsDepthRead()
576 ? FExclusiveDepthStencil::DepthWrite
577 : FExclusiveDepthStencil::DepthNop;
578
579 FExclusiveDepthStencil::Type NewStencilState = IsStencilRead()
580 ? FExclusiveDepthStencil::StencilWrite
581 : FExclusiveDepthStencil::StencilNop;
582
583 return (FExclusiveDepthStencil::Type)(NewDepthState | NewStencilState);
584 }
585
586 uint32 GetIndex() const
587 {
588 // Note: The array to index has views created in that specific order.
589
590 // we don't care about the Nop versions so less views are needed
591 // we combine Nop and Write
592 switch (Value)
593 {
594 case DepthWrite_StencilNop:
595 case DepthNop_StencilWrite:
596 case DepthWrite_StencilWrite:
597 case DepthNop_StencilNop:
598 return 0; // old DSAT_Writable
599
600 case DepthRead_StencilNop:
601 case DepthRead_StencilWrite:
602 return 1; // old DSAT_ReadOnlyDepth
603
604 case DepthNop_StencilRead:
605 case DepthWrite_StencilRead:
606 return 2; // old DSAT_ReadOnlyStencil
607
608 case DepthRead_StencilRead:
609 return 3; // old DSAT_ReadOnlyDepthAndStencil
610 }
611 // should never happen
612 check(0);
613 return -1;
614 }
615 static const uint32 MaxIndex = 4;
616
617private:
618 inline Type ExtractDepth() const
619 {
620 return (Type)(Value & DepthMask);
621 }
622 inline Type ExtractStencil() const
623 {
624 return (Type)(Value & StencilMask);
625 }
626 friend uint32 GetTypeHash(const FExclusiveDepthStencil& Ds);
627};

665template <typename RHIState, typename RHIStateInitializer>
666static bool MatchRHIState(RHIState* LHSState, RHIState* RHSState)
667{
668 RHIStateInitializer LHSStateInitializerRHI;
669 RHIStateInitializer RHSStateInitializerRHI;
670 if (LHSState)
671 {
672 LHSState->GetInitializer(LHSStateInitializerRHI);
673 }
674 if (RHSState)
675 {
676 RHSState->GetInitializer(RHSStateInitializerRHI);
677 }
678 return LHSStateInitializerRHI == RHSStateInitializerRHI;
679}

717struct FShaderResourceTable
718{
720 uint32 ResourceTableBits = 0;
721
723 TArray<uint32> ShaderResourceViewMap;
724
726 TArray<uint32> SamplerMap;
727
729 TArray<uint32> UnorderedAccessViewMap;
730
732 TArray<uint32> ResourceTableLayoutHashes;
733
735 TArray<uint32> TextureMap;
736
738 TArray<uint32> ResourceCollectionMap;
739
740 friend bool operator == (const FShaderResourceTable& A, const FShaderResourceTable& B)
741 {
742 bool bEqual = true;
743 bEqual &= (A.ResourceTableBits == B.ResourceTableBits);
744 bEqual &= (A.ShaderResourceViewMap .Num() == B.ShaderResourceViewMap .Num());
745 bEqual &= (A.SamplerMap .Num() == B.SamplerMap .Num());
746 bEqual &= (A.UnorderedAccessViewMap .Num() == B.UnorderedAccessViewMap .Num());
747 bEqual &= (A.ResourceTableLayoutHashes.Num() == B.ResourceTableLayoutHashes.Num());
748 bEqual &= (A.TextureMap .Num() == B.TextureMap .Num());
749 bEqual &= (A.ResourceCollectionMap .Num() == B.ResourceCollectionMap .Num());
750
751 if (!bEqual)
752 {
753 return false;
754 }
755
756 bEqual &= (FMemory::Memcmp(A.ShaderResourceViewMap .GetData(), B.ShaderResourceViewMap .GetData(), A.ShaderResourceViewMap .GetTypeSize() * A.ShaderResourceViewMap .Num()) == 0);
757 bEqual &= (FMemory::Memcmp(A.SamplerMap .GetData(), B.SamplerMap .GetData(), A.SamplerMap .GetTypeSize() * A.SamplerMap .Num()) == 0);
758 bEqual &= (FMemory::Memcmp(A.UnorderedAccessViewMap .GetData(), B.UnorderedAccessViewMap .GetData(), A.UnorderedAccessViewMap .GetTypeSize() * A.UnorderedAccessViewMap .Num()) == 0);
759 bEqual &= (FMemory::Memcmp(A.ResourceTableLayoutHashes.GetData(), B.ResourceTableLayoutHashes.GetData(), A.ResourceTableLayoutHashes.GetTypeSize() * A.ResourceTableLayoutHashes.Num()) == 0);
760 bEqual &= (FMemory::Memcmp(A.TextureMap .GetData(), B.TextureMap .GetData(), A.TextureMap .GetTypeSize() * A.TextureMap .Num()) == 0);
761 bEqual &= (FMemory::Memcmp(A.ResourceCollectionMap .GetData(), B.ResourceCollectionMap .GetData(), A.ResourceCollectionMap .GetTypeSize() * A.ResourceCollectionMap .Num()) == 0);
762 return bEqual;
763 }
764
765 friend FArchive& operator << (FArchive& Ar, FShaderResourceTable& SRT)
766 {
767 Ar << SRT.ResourceTableBits;
768 Ar << SRT.ShaderResourceViewMap;
769 Ar << SRT.SamplerMap;
770 Ar << SRT.UnorderedAccessViewMap;
771 Ar << SRT.ResourceTableLayoutHashes;
772 Ar << SRT.TextureMap;
773 Ar << SRT.ResourceCollectionMap;
774
775 return Ar;
776 }
777};

783 // Workaround for layering issue. FShaderParametersMetadata is in RenderCore,
784 // so we can't move the logic for initializing the StaticSlots array to the RHI module.

1370struct FRHIBufferDesc
1371{
1373 uint32 Size = 0;
1374
1376 uint32 Stride = 0;
1377
1379 EBufferUsageFlags Usage = EBufferUsageFlags::None;
1380
1381 /* A mask representing which GPUs to create the resource on, in a multi-GPU system. */
1382 FRHIGPUMask GPUMask = FRHIGPUMask::All();
1383
1384 FRHIBufferDesc() = default;
1385 FRHIBufferDesc(uint32 InSize, uint32 InStride, EBufferUsageFlags InUsage)
1386 : Size (InSize)
1387 , Stride(InStride)
1388 , Usage (InUsage)
1389 {
1390 }
1391 FRHIBufferDesc(uint32 InSize, uint32 InStride, EBufferUsageFlags InUsage, FRHIGPUMask InGPUMask)
1392 : Size (InSize)
1393 , Stride (InStride)
1394 , Usage (InUsage)
1395 , GPUMask(InGPUMask)
1396 {
1397 }
1398
1399 static FRHIBufferDesc Null()
1400 {
1401 return FRHIBufferDesc(0, 0, EBufferUsageFlags::NullResource);
1402 }
1403
1404 bool IsNull() const
1405 {
1406 if (EnumHasAnyFlags(Usage, EBufferUsageFlags::NullResource))
1407 {
1408 // The null resource descriptor should have its other fields zeroed, and no additional flags.
1409 check(Size == 0 && Stride == 0 && Usage == EBufferUsageFlags::NullResource);
1410 return true;
1411 }
1412
1413 return false;
1414 }
1415
1416 friend uint32 GetTypeHash(const FRHIBufferDesc& Desc)
1417 {
1418 uint32 Hash = GetTypeHash(Desc.Size);
1419 Hash = HashCombine(Hash, GetTypeHash(Desc.Stride));
1420 Hash = HashCombine(Hash, GetTypeHash(Desc.Usage));
1421 Hash = HashCombine(Hash, GetTypeHash(Desc.GPUMask.GetNative()));
1422 return Hash;
1423 }
1424
1425 bool operator==(const FRHIBufferDesc& Other) const
1426 {
1427 return Size == Other.Size
1428 && Stride == Other.Stride
1429 && Usage == Other.Usage
1430 && GPUMask == Other.GPUMask;
1431 }
1432
1433 bool operator!=(const FRHIBufferDesc& Other) const
1434 {
1435 return !(*this == Other);
1436 }
1437
1438 FRHIBufferDesc& operator=(const FRHIBufferDesc& Other)
1439 {
1440 Size = Other.Size;
1441 Stride = Other.Stride;
1442 Usage = Other.Usage;
1443 GPUMask = Other.GPUMask;
1444
1445 return *this;
1446 }
1447};

1716struct FRHITextureDesc
1717{
1718 FRHITextureDesc() = default;
1719
1720 FRHITextureDesc(const FRHITextureDesc& Other)
1721 {
1722 *this = Other;
1723 }
1724
1725 FRHITextureDesc(ETextureDimension InDimension)
1726 : Dimension(InDimension)
1727 {}
1728
1729 FRHITextureDesc(
1730 ETextureDimension InDimension
1731 , ETextureCreateFlags InFlags
1732 , EPixelFormat InFormat
1733 , FClearValueBinding InClearValue
1734 , FIntPoint InExtent
1735 , uint16 InDepth
1736 , uint16 InArraySize
1737 , uint8 InNumMips
1738 , uint8 InNumSamples
1739 , uint32 InExtData
1740 )
1741 : Flags (InFlags )
1742 , ClearValue(InClearValue)
1743 , ExtData (InExtData )
1744 , Extent (InExtent )
1745 , Depth (InDepth )
1746 , ArraySize (InArraySize )
1747 , NumMips (InNumMips )
1748 , NumSamples(InNumSamples)
1749 , Dimension (InDimension )
1750 , Format (InFormat )
1751 {}
1752
1753 friend uint32 GetTypeHash(const FRHITextureDesc& Desc)
1754 {
1755 uint32 Hash = GetTypeHash(Desc.Dimension);
1756 Hash = HashCombine(Hash, GetTypeHash(Desc.Flags ));
1757 Hash = HashCombine(Hash, GetTypeHash(Desc.Format ));
1758 Hash = HashCombine(Hash, GetTypeHash(Desc.UAVFormat ));
1759 Hash = HashCombine(Hash, GetTypeHash(Desc.Extent ));
1760 Hash = HashCombine(Hash, GetTypeHash(Desc.Depth ));
1761 Hash = HashCombine(Hash, GetTypeHash(Desc.ArraySize ));
1762 Hash = HashCombine(Hash, GetTypeHash(Desc.NumMips ));
1763 Hash = HashCombine(Hash, GetTypeHash(Desc.NumSamples));
1764 Hash = HashCombine(Hash, GetTypeHash(Desc.FastVRAMPercentage));
1765 Hash = HashCombine(Hash, GetTypeHash(Desc.ClearValue));
1766 Hash = HashCombine(Hash, GetTypeHash(Desc.ExtData ));
1767 Hash = HashCombine(Hash, GetTypeHash(Desc.GPUMask.GetNative()));
1768 Hash = HashCombine(Hash, GetTypeHash(Desc.AliasableFormats));
1769 // Add BlockBytes to the hash computation to handle cases where PixelFormat changes at runtime (e.g., PF_SceneDepth).
1770 // This ensures the hash correctly reflects changes in block size, preventing potential mismatches or incorrect caching when the pixel format varies dynamically.
1771 Hash = HashCombine(Hash, GetTypeHash(GPixelFormats[Desc.Format].BlockBytes));
1772 return Hash;
1773 }
1774
1775 bool operator == (const FRHITextureDesc& Other) const
1776 {
1777 return Dimension == Other.Dimension
1778 && Flags == Other.Flags
1779 && Format == Other.Format
1780 && UAVFormat == Other.UAVFormat
1781 && Extent == Other.Extent
1782 && Depth == Other.Depth
1783 && ArraySize == Other.ArraySize
1784 && NumMips == Other.NumMips
1785 && NumSamples == Other.NumSamples
1786 && FastVRAMPercentage == Other.FastVRAMPercentage
1787 && ClearValue == Other.ClearValue
1788 && ExtData == Other.ExtData
1789 && GPUMask == Other.GPUMask
1790 && AliasableFormats == Other.AliasableFormats;
1791 }
1792
1793 bool operator != (const FRHITextureDesc& Other) const
1794 {
1795 return !(*this == Other);
1796 }
1797
1798 FRHITextureDesc& operator=(const FRHITextureDesc& Other)
1799 {
1800 Dimension = Other.Dimension;
1801 Flags = Other.Flags;
1802 Format = Other.Format;
1803 UAVFormat = Other.UAVFormat;
1804 Extent = Other.Extent;
1805 Depth = Other.Depth;
1806 ArraySize = Other.ArraySize;
1807 NumMips = Other.NumMips;
1808 NumSamples = Other.NumSamples;
1809 ClearValue = Other.ClearValue;
1810 ExtData = Other.ExtData;
1811 FastVRAMPercentage = Other.FastVRAMPercentage;
1812 GPUMask = Other.GPUMask;
1813 AliasableFormats = Other.AliasableFormats;
1814
1815 return *this;
1816 }
1817
1818 bool IsTexture2D() const
1819 {
1820 return Dimension == ETextureDimension::Texture2D || Dimension == ETextureDimension::Texture2DArray;
1821 }
1822
1823 bool IsTexture3D() const
1824 {
1825 return Dimension == ETextureDimension::Texture3D;
1826 }
1827
1828 bool IsTextureCube() const
1829 {
1830 return Dimension == ETextureDimension::TextureCube || Dimension == ETextureDimension::TextureCubeArray;
1831 }
1832
1833 bool IsTextureArray() const
1834 {
1835 return Dimension == ETextureDimension::Texture2DArray || Dimension == ETextureDimension::TextureCubeArray;
1836 }
1837
1838 bool IsMipChain() const
1839 {
1840 return NumMips > 1;
1841 }
1842
1843 bool IsMultisample() const
1844 {
1845 return NumSamples > 1;
1846 }
1847
1848 FIntVector GetSize() const
1849 {
1850 return FIntVector(Extent.X, Extent.Y, Depth);
1851 }
1852
1853 void Reset()
1854 {
1855 // Usually we don't want to propagate MSAA samples.
1856 NumSamples = 1;
1857
1858 // Remove UAV flag for textures that don't need it (some formats are incompatible).
1859 Flags |= TexCreate_RenderTargetable;
1860 Flags &= ~(TexCreate_UAV | TexCreate_ResolveTargetable | TexCreate_DepthStencilResolveTarget | TexCreate_Memoryless);
1861
1862 AliasableFormats.Empty();
1863 }
1864
1866 bool IsValid() const
1867 {
1868 return FRHITextureDesc::Validate(*this, /* Name = */ TEXT(""), /* bFatal = */ false);
1869 }
1870
1872 ETextureCreateFlags Flags = TexCreate_None;
1873
1875 FClearValueBinding ClearValue;
1876
1877 /* A mask representing which GPUs to create the resource on, in a multi-GPU system. */
1878 FRHIGPUMask GPUMask = FRHIGPUMask::All();
1879
1881 uint32 ExtData = 0;
1882
1884 FIntPoint Extent = FIntPoint(1, 1);
1885
1887 uint16 Depth = 1;
1888
1890 uint16 ArraySize = 1;
1891
1893 uint8 NumMips = 1;
1894
1896 uint8 NumSamples = 1;
1897
1899 ETextureDimension Dimension = ETextureDimension::Texture2D;
1900
1902 EPixelFormat Format = PF_Unknown;
1903
1905 EPixelFormat UAVFormat = PF_Unknown;
1906
1908 uint8 FastVRAMPercentage = 0xFF;
1909
1911 TArray<EPixelFormat, TInlineAllocator<1>> AliasableFormats;
1912
1914 static bool CheckValidity(const FRHITextureDesc& Desc, const TCHAR* Name)
1915 {
1916 return FRHITextureDesc::Validate(Desc, Name, /* bFatal = */ true);
1917 }
1918
1929 RHI_API uint64 CalcMemorySizeEstimate(uint32 FirstMipIndex, uint32 LastMipIndex) const;
1930
1931 uint64 CalcMemorySizeEstimate(uint32 FirstMipIndex = 0) const
1932 {
1933 return CalcMemorySizeEstimate(FirstMipIndex, NumMips - 1);
1934 }
1935
1936 uint16 GetSubresourceCount() const
1937 {
1938 uint16 NumFaces = ((Dimension == ETextureDimension::TextureCube) || (Dimension == ETextureDimension::TextureCubeArray)) ? 6 : 1;
1939 uint16 NumPlanes = (IsStencilFormat(Format) || Format == PF_D24) ? 2 : 1;
1940
1941 return (ArraySize * (NumMips * NumFaces) * NumPlanes);
1942 }
1943
1944private:
1945 RHI_API static bool Validate(const FRHITextureDesc& Desc, const TCHAR* Name, bool bFatal);
1946};

2680template <typename TType>
2681struct TRHIRange
2682{
2683 TType First = 0;
2684 TType Num = 0;
2685
2686 TRHIRange() = default;
2687 TRHIRange(uint32 InFirst, uint32 InNum)
2688 : First(InFirst)
2689 , Num (InNum)
2690 {
2691 check( InFirst < TNumericLimits<TType>::Max()
2692 && InNum < TNumericLimits<TType>::Max()
2693 && (InFirst + InNum) < TNumericLimits<TType>::Max());
2694 }
2695
2696 TType ExclusiveLast() const { return First + Num; }
2697 TType InclusiveLast() const { return First + Num - 1; }
2698
2699 bool IsInRange(uint32 Value) const
2700 {
2701 check(Value < TNumericLimits<TType>::Max());
2702 return Value >= First && Value < ExclusiveLast();
2703 }
2704};
2705
2706using FRHIRange8 = TRHIRange<uint8>;

2709//
2710// The unified RHI view descriptor. These are stored in the base FRHIView type, and packed to minimize memory usage.
2711// Platform RHI implementations use the GetViewInfo() functions to convert an FRHIViewDesc into the required info to make a view / descriptor for the GPU.
2712//
2713struct FRHIViewDesc
2714{
2715 enum class EViewType : uint8
2716 {
2717 BufferSRV,
2718 BufferUAV,
2719 TextureSRV,
2720 TextureUAV
2721 };
2722
2723 enum class EBufferType : uint8
2724 {
2725 Unknown = 0,
2726
2727 Typed = 1,
2728 Structured = 2,
2729 AccelerationStructure = 3,
2730 Raw = 4
2731 };
2732
2733 enum class EDimension : uint8
2734 {
2735 Unknown = 0,
2736
2737 Texture2D = 1,
2738 Texture2DArray = 2,
2739 TextureCube = 3,
2740 TextureCubeArray = 4,
2741 Texture3D = 5,
2742
2743 NumBits = 3
2744 };
2745
2746 // Properties that apply to all views.
2747 struct FCommon
2748 {
2749 EViewType ViewType;
2750 EPixelFormat Format;
2751 };
2752
2753 // Properties shared by buffer views. Some fields are SRV or UAV specific.
2754 struct FBuffer : public FCommon
2755 {
2756 EBufferType BufferType;
2757 uint8 bAtomicCounter : 1; // UAV only
2758 uint8 bAppendBuffer : 1; // UAV only
2759 uint8 /* padding */ : 6;
2760 uint32 OffsetInBytes;
2761 union
2762 {
2763 struct
2764 {
2765 uint32 NumElements;
2766 uint32 Stride;
2767 };
2768 FRHIRayTracingScene* RayTracingScene; // only if BufferType == AccelerationStructure
2769 };
2770
2771 struct FViewInfo;
2772 protected:
2773 FViewInfo GetViewInfo(FRHIBuffer* TargetBuffer) const;
2774 };
2775
2776 // Properties shared by texture views. Some fields are SRV or UAV specific.
2777 struct FTexture : public FCommon
2778 {
2779 ERHITexturePlane Plane : uint32(ERHITexturePlane::NumBits);
2780 uint8 bDisableSRGB : 1; // SRV only
2781 EDimension Dimension : uint32(EDimension::NumBits);
2782 FRHIRange8 MipRange; // UAVs only support 1 mip
2783 FRHIRange16 ArrayRange;
2784
2785 struct FViewInfo;
2786 protected:
2787 FViewInfo GetViewInfo(FRHITexture* TargetTexture) const;
2788 };
2789
2790 struct FBufferSRV : public FBuffer
2791 {
2792 struct FInitializer;
2793 struct FViewInfo;
2794 RHI_API FViewInfo GetViewInfo(FRHIBuffer* TargetBuffer) const;
2795 };
2796
2797 struct FBufferUAV : public FBuffer
2798 {
2799 struct FInitializer;
2800 struct FViewInfo;
2801 RHI_API FViewInfo GetViewInfo(FRHIBuffer* TargetBuffer) const;
2802 };
2803
2804 struct FTextureSRV : public FTexture
2805 {
2806 struct FInitializer;
2807 struct FViewInfo;
2808 RHI_API FViewInfo GetViewInfo(FRHITexture* TargetTexture) const;
2809 };
2810
2811 struct FTextureUAV : public FTexture
2812 {
2813 struct FInitializer;
2814 struct FViewInfo;
2815 RHI_API FViewInfo GetViewInfo(FRHITexture* TargetTexture) const;
2816 };
2817
2818 union
2819 {
2820 FCommon Common;
2821 union
2822 {
2823 FBufferSRV SRV;
2824 FBufferUAV UAV;
2825 } Buffer;
2826 union
2827 {
2828 FTextureSRV SRV;
2829 FTextureUAV UAV;
2830 } Texture;
2831 };
2832
2833 static inline FBufferSRV::FInitializer CreateBufferSRV();
2834 static inline FBufferUAV::FInitializer CreateBufferUAV();
2835
2836 static inline FTextureSRV::FInitializer CreateTextureSRV();
2837 static inline FTextureUAV::FInitializer CreateTextureUAV();
2838
2839 bool IsSRV() const { return Common.ViewType == EViewType::BufferSRV || Common.ViewType == EViewType::TextureSRV; }
2840 bool IsUAV() const { return !IsSRV(); }
2841
2842 bool IsBuffer () const { return Common.ViewType == EViewType::BufferSRV || Common.ViewType == EViewType::BufferUAV; }
2843 bool IsTexture() const { return !IsBuffer(); }
2844
2845 bool operator == (FRHIViewDesc const& RHS) const
2846 {
2847 return FMemory::Memcmp(this, &RHS, sizeof(*this)) == 0;
2848 }
2849
2850 bool operator != (FRHIViewDesc const& RHS) const
2851 {
2852 return !(*this == RHS);
2853 }
2854
2855 FRHIViewDesc()
2856 : FRHIViewDesc(EViewType::BufferSRV)
2857 {
2858 FMemory::Memzero(*this);
2859 }
2860
2861 static const TCHAR* GetBufferTypeString(EBufferType BufferType);
2862 static const TCHAR* GetTextureDimensionString(EDimension Dimension);
2863
2864protected:
2865 FRHIViewDesc(EViewType ViewType)
2866 {
2867 FMemory::Memzero(*this);
2868 Common.ViewType = ViewType;
2869 }
2870};

2873// If they fail, consider re-packing the struct.

2875static_assert(TIsTrivial<FRHIViewDesc>::Value, "FRHIViewDesc must be a trivial type.");

2877struct FRHIViewDesc::FBufferSRV::FInitializer : private FRHIViewDesc
2878{
2879 friend FRHIViewDesc;
2880 friend FRHICommandListBase;
2881 friend struct FShaderResourceViewInitializer;
2882 friend struct FRawBufferShaderResourceViewInitializer;

2884protected:
2885 FInitializer()
2886 : FRHIViewDesc(EViewType::BufferSRV)
2887 {}

2889public:
2890 FInitializer& SetType(EBufferType Type)
2891 {
2892 check(Type != EBufferType::Unknown);
2893 Buffer.SRV.BufferType = Type;
2894 return *this;
2895 }
2896
2897 //
2898 // Provided for back-compat with existing code. Consider using SetType() instead for more direct control over the view.
2899 // For example, it is possible to create a typed view of a BUF_ByteAddress buffer, but not using this function which always choses raw access.
2900 //
2901 FInitializer& SetTypeFromBuffer(FRHIBuffer* TargetBuffer)
2902 {
2903 check(TargetBuffer);
2904 checkf(!TargetBuffer->GetDesc().IsNull(), TEXT("Null buffer resources are placeholders for the streaming system. They do not contain a valid descriptor for this function to use. Call SetType() instead."));
2905
2906 Buffer.SRV.BufferType =
2907 EnumHasAnyFlags(TargetBuffer->GetUsage(), BUF_ByteAddressBuffer ) ? EBufferType::Raw :
2908 EnumHasAnyFlags(TargetBuffer->GetUsage(), BUF_StructuredBuffer ) ? EBufferType::Structured :
2909 EnumHasAnyFlags(TargetBuffer->GetUsage(), BUF_AccelerationStructure) ? EBufferType::AccelerationStructure :
2910 EBufferType::Typed;
2911 return *this;
2912 }
2913
2914 FInitializer& SetFormat(EPixelFormat InFormat)
2915 {
2916 Buffer.SRV.Format = InFormat;
2917 return *this;
2918 }
2919
2920 FInitializer& SetOffsetInBytes(uint32 InOffsetBytes)
2921 {
2922 Buffer.SRV.OffsetInBytes = InOffsetBytes;
2923 return *this;
2924 }
2925
2926 FInitializer& SetStride(uint32 InStride)
2927 {
2928 check(Buffer.SRV.BufferType != EBufferType::Unknown && Buffer.SRV.BufferType != EBufferType::AccelerationStructure);
2929 Buffer.SRV.Stride = InStride;
2930 return *this;
2931 }
2932
2933 FInitializer& SetNumElements(uint32 InNumElements)
2934 {
2935 check(Buffer.SRV.BufferType != EBufferType::Unknown && Buffer.SRV.BufferType != EBufferType::AccelerationStructure);
2936 Buffer.SRV.NumElements = InNumElements;
2937 return *this;
2938 }
2939
2940 FInitializer& SetRayTracingScene(FRHIRayTracingScene* InRayTracingScene)
2941 {
2942 check(Buffer.SRV.BufferType == EBufferType::AccelerationStructure);
2943 Buffer.SRV.RayTracingScene = InRayTracingScene;
2944 return *this;
2945 }

3020struct FRHIViewDesc::FTextureSRV::FInitializer : private FRHIViewDesc
3021{
3022 friend FRHIViewDesc;
3023 friend FRHICommandListBase;
3024
3025protected:
3026 FInitializer()
3027 : FRHIViewDesc(EViewType::TextureSRV)
3028 {}
3029
3030public:
3031 //
3032 // Specifies the type of view to create. Must match the shader parameter this view will be bound to.
3033 //
3034 // The dimension is allowed to differ from the underlying resource's dimensions, e.g. to create a view
3035 // compatible with a Texture2D<> shader parameter, but where the underlying resource is a texture 2D array.
3036 //
3037 // Some combinations are not valid, e.g. 3D textures can only have 3D views.
3038 //
3039 FInitializer& SetDimension(ETextureDimension InDimension)
3040 {
3041 switch (InDimension)
3042 {
3043 default: checkNoEntry(); break;
3044 case ETextureDimension::Texture2D : Texture.SRV.Dimension = EDimension::Texture2D ; break;
3045 case ETextureDimension::Texture2DArray : Texture.SRV.Dimension = EDimension::Texture2DArray ; break;
3046 case ETextureDimension::Texture3D : Texture.SRV.Dimension = EDimension::Texture3D ; break;
3047 case ETextureDimension::TextureCube : Texture.SRV.Dimension = EDimension::TextureCube ; break;
3048 case ETextureDimension::TextureCubeArray: Texture.SRV.Dimension = EDimension::TextureCubeArray; break;
3049 }
3050 return *this;
3051 }
3052
3053 //
3054 // Provided for back-compat with existing code. Consider using SetDimension() instead for more direct control over the view.
3055 // For example, it is possible to create a 2D view of a 2DArray texture, but not using this function which always choses 2DArray dimension.
3056 //
3057 FInitializer& SetDimensionFromTexture(FRHITexture* TargetTexture)
3058 {
3059 check(TargetTexture);
3060 SetDimension(TargetTexture->GetDesc().Dimension);
3061 return *this;
3062 }
3063
3064 FInitializer& SetFormat(EPixelFormat InFormat)
3065 {

3083 //
3084 // The meaning of array "elements" is given by the dimension of the underlying resource.
3085 // I.e. a view of a TextureCubeArray resource indexes the array in whole cubes.

3087 // [0] = the first cube (2D slices 0 to 5)

3090 // If the view dimension is smaller than the resource dimension, the array range will be further limited.

3107struct FRHIViewDesc::FTextureUAV::FInitializer : private FRHIViewDesc
3108{
3109 friend FRHIViewDesc;
3110 friend FRHICommandListBase;
3111
3112protected:
3113 FInitializer()
3114 : FRHIViewDesc(EViewType::TextureUAV)
3115 {
3116 // Texture UAVs only support 1 mip
3117 Texture.UAV.MipRange.Num = 1;
3118 }
3119
3120public:
3121 //
3122 // Specifies the type of view to create. Must match the shader parameter this view will be bound to.
3123 //
3124 // The dimension is allowed to differ from the underlying resource's dimensions, e.g. to create a view
3125 // compatible with an RWTexture2D<> shader parameter, but where the underlying resource is a texture 2D array.
3126 //
3127 // Some combinations are not valid, e.g. 3D textures can only have 3D views.
3128 //
3129 FInitializer& SetDimension(ETextureDimension InDimension)
3130 {
3131 switch (InDimension)
3132 {
3133 default: checkNoEntry(); break;
3134 case ETextureDimension::Texture2D : Texture.UAV.Dimension = EDimension::Texture2D ; break;
3135 case ETextureDimension::Texture2DArray : Texture.UAV.Dimension = EDimension::Texture2DArray ; break;
3136 case ETextureDimension::Texture3D : Texture.UAV.Dimension = EDimension::Texture3D ; break;
3137 case ETextureDimension::TextureCube : Texture.UAV.Dimension = EDimension::TextureCube ; break;
3138 case ETextureDimension::TextureCubeArray: Texture.UAV.Dimension = EDimension::TextureCubeArray; break;
3139 }
3140 return *this;
3141 }
3142
3143 //
3144 // Provided for back-compat with existing code. Consider using SetDimension() instead for more direct control over the view.
3145 // For example, it is possible to create a 2D view of a 2DArray texture, but not using this function which always choses 2DArray dimension.
3146 //
3147 FInitializer& SetDimensionFromTexture(FRHITexture* TargetTexture)
3148 {
3149 check(TargetTexture);
3150 SetDimension(TargetTexture->GetDesc().Dimension);
3151 return *this;
3152 }
3153
3154 FInitializer& SetFormat(EPixelFormat InFormat)
3155 {
3156 Texture.UAV.Format = InFormat;
3157 return *this;
3158 }
3159
3160 FInitializer& SetPlane(ERHITexturePlane InPlane)
3161 {
3162 Texture.UAV.Plane = InPlane;
3163 return *this;
3164 }
3165
3166 FInitializer& SetMipLevel(uint8 InMipLevel)
3167 {
3168 Texture.UAV.MipRange.First = InMipLevel;
3169 return *this;
3170 }
3171
3172 //
3173 // The meaning of array "elements" is given by the dimension of the underlying resource.
3174 // I.e. a view of a TextureCubeArray resource indexes the array in whole cubes.
3175 //
3176 // [0] = the first cube (2D slices 0 to 5)
3177 // [1] = the second cube (2D slices 6 to 11)
3178 //
3179 // If the view dimension is smaller than the resource dimension, the array range will be further limited.
3180 // E.g. creating a Texture2D dimension view of a TextureCubeArray resource
3181 //
3182 FInitializer& SetArrayRange(uint16 InFirstElement, uint16 InNumElements)
3183 {
3184 Texture.UAV.ArrayRange.First = InFirstElement;
3185 Texture.UAV.ArrayRange.Num = InNumElements;
3186 return *this;
3187 }
3188};

3210//

3253struct FRHIViewDesc::FTexture::FViewInfo
3254{

3256 // The range of array "elements" the view covers.
3257 //
3258 // The meaning of "elements" is given by the view dimension.

3260 //
3261 // - [0]: the first cube (2D slices 0 to 5)

3277
3278 // True when the view covers every mip of the resource.

3404// Ray tracing resources

3406
3407struct FRayTracingGeometryOfflineDataHeader
3408{
3409 uint32 Reserved[6] = { 0xFFFFFFFF, 0xFFFFFFFF, 0xFFFFFFFF, 0xFFFFFFFF, 0xFFFFFFFF, 0xFFFFFFFF };
3410
3411 bool IsValid() const
3412 {
3413 return *this != FRayTracingGeometryOfflineDataHeader();
3414 }
3415
3416 bool operator==(const FRayTracingGeometryOfflineDataHeader& Other) const
3417 {
3418 return Reserved[0] == Other.Reserved[0]
3419 && Reserved[1] == Other.Reserved[1]
3420 && Reserved[2] == Other.Reserved[2]
3421 && Reserved[3] == Other.Reserved[3]
3422 && Reserved[4] == Other.Reserved[4]
3423 && Reserved[5] == Other.Reserved[5];
3424 }
3425
3426 bool operator!=(const FRayTracingGeometryOfflineDataHeader& Other) const
3427 {
3428 return !(*this == Other);
3429 }
3430
3431 friend FArchive& operator<<(FArchive& Ar, FRayTracingGeometryOfflineDataHeader& Header)
3432 {
3433 Ar << Header.Reserved[0];
3434 Ar << Header.Reserved[1];
3435 Ar << Header.Reserved[2];
3436 Ar << Header.Reserved[3];
3437 Ar << Header.Reserved[4];
3438 Ar << Header.Reserved[5];
3439 return Ar;
3440 }
3441};
3442
3443enum ERayTracingGeometryType
3444{
3445 // Indexed or non-indexed triangle list with fixed function ray intersection.
3446 // Vertex buffer must contain vertex positions as VET_Float3.
3447 // Vertex stride must be at least 12 bytes, but may be larger to support custom per-vertex data.
3448 // Index buffer may be provided for indexed triangle lists. Implicit triangle list is assumed otherwise.
3449 RTGT_Triangles,
3450
3451 // Custom primitive type that requires an intersection shader.
3452 // Vertex buffer for procedural geometry must contain one AABB per primitive as {float3 MinXYZ, float3 MaxXYZ}.
3453 // Vertex stride must be at least 24 bytes, but may be larger to support custom per-primitive data.
3454 // Index buffers can't be used with procedural geometry.
3455 RTGT_Procedural,
3456
3457 // Linear Swept Sphere (LSS) is a ray tracing primitive that represents the volume traced by a sphere moving
3458 // linearly between two endpoints, optionally with varying radii. It efficiently models strand-like geometry
3459 // such as hair or fur without tessellating into triangles, offering smoother appearance, lower memory use,
3460 // and hardware-accelerated ray intersections.
3461 RTGT_LinearSweptSpheres,
3462};
3463DECLARE_INTRINSIC_TYPE_LAYOUT(ERayTracingGeometryType);
3464
3465enum class ERayTracingGeometryInitializerType : uint8
3466{
3467 // Fully initializes the RayTracingGeometry object: creates underlying buffer and initializes shader parameters.
3468 Rendering,
3469
3470 // Does not create underlying buffer or shader parameters. Used by the streaming system as an object that is streamed into.
3471 StreamingDestination,
3472
3473 // Creates buffers but does not create shader parameters. Used for intermediate objects in the streaming system.
3474 StreamingSource,
3475};
3476DECLARE_INTRINSIC_TYPE_LAYOUT(ERayTracingGeometryInitializerType);
3477
3478struct FRayTracingGeometrySegment
3479{
3480public:
3481 FBufferRHIRef VertexBuffer = nullptr;
3482 EVertexElementType VertexBufferElementType = VET_Float3;
3483
3484 // Offset in bytes from the base address of the vertex buffer.
3485 uint32 VertexBufferOffset = 0;
3486
3487 // Number of bytes between elements of the vertex buffer (sizeof VET_Float3 by default).
3488 // Must be equal or greater than the size of the position vector.
3489 uint32 VertexBufferStride = 12;
3490
3491 // Number of vertices (positions) in VertexBuffer.
3492 // If an index buffer is present, this must be at least the maximum index value in the index buffer + 1.
3493 uint32 MaxVertices = 0;
3494
3495 // Primitive range for this segment.
3496 uint32 FirstPrimitive = 0;
3497 uint32 NumPrimitives = 0;
3498
3499 // Indicates whether any-hit shader could be invoked when hitting this geometry segment.
3500 // Setting this to `false` turns off any-hit shaders, making the section "opaque" and improving ray tracing performance.
3501 bool bForceOpaque = false;
3502
3503 // Any-hit shader may be invoked multiple times for the same primitive during ray traversal.
3504 // Setting this to `false` guarantees that only a single instance of any-hit shader will run per primitive, at some performance cost.
3505 bool bAllowDuplicateAnyHitShaderInvocation = true;
3506
3507 // Indicates whether this section is enabled and should be taken into account during acceleration structure creation
3508 bool bEnabled = true;
3509};
3510
3511struct FRayTracingGeometryInitializer
3512{
3513public:
3514 FBufferRHIRef IndexBuffer = nullptr;
3515
3516 // Offset in bytes from the base address of the index buffer.
3517 uint32 IndexBufferOffset = 0;
3518
3519 // Stride in bytes of the index buffer (2 for 16-bit indices, 4 for 32-bit).
3520 uint32 IndexBufferStride = 0;
3521
3522 ERayTracingGeometryType GeometryType = RTGT_Triangles;
3523
3524 // Total number of primitives in all segments of the geometry. Only used for validation.
3525 uint32 TotalPrimitiveCount = 0;
3526
3527 bool bFastBuild = false;
3528 bool bAllowUpdate = false;
3529 bool bAllowCompaction = true;
3530 bool bTemplate = false;
3531 ERayTracingGeometryInitializerType Type = ERayTracingGeometryInitializerType::Rendering;
3532
3533 // Partitions of geometry to allow different shader and resource bindings.
3534 // All ray tracing geometries must have at least one segment.
3535 TArray<FRayTracingGeometrySegment> Segments;
3536
3537 // Offline built geometry data. If null, the geometry will be built by the RHI at runtime.
3538 FResourceArrayUploadInterface* OfflineData = nullptr;
3539 FRayTracingGeometryOfflineDataHeader OfflineDataHeader;
3540
3541 // Pointer to an existing ray tracing geometry which the new geometry is built from.
3542 FRHIRayTracingGeometry* SourceGeometry = nullptr;
3543
3544 // Use FDebugName for auto-generated debug names with numbered suffixes, it is a variation of FMemoryImageName with optional number postfix.
3545 FDebugName DebugName;
3546 // Store the path name of the owner object for resource tracking. FMemoryImageName allows a conversion to/from FName.
3547 FName OwnerName;
3548
3549 uint32 GetIndexBufferStride() const
3550 {
3551 if (IndexBufferStride != 0)
3552 {
3553 return IndexBufferStride;
3554 }
3555
3556 if (IndexBuffer)
3557 {
3558 ensureMsgf(false,
3559 TEXT("FRayTracingGeometryInitializer::IndexBufferStride not set; falling back to IndexBuffer->GetStride(). ")
3560 TEXT("Set IndexBufferStride when building the initializer to avoid a data race with index buffer streaming."));
3561 return IndexBuffer->GetStride();
3562 }
3563
3564 return 0;
3565 }
3566};
3567
3568#if DO_CHECK
3569inline bool operator==(const FRayTracingGeometryInitializer& LHS, const FRayTracingGeometryInitializer& RHS)
3570{
3571 // Can't compare LHS == RHS directly due to some members not having equality operators
3572
3573 if (LHS.IndexBuffer != RHS.IndexBuffer
3574 || LHS.IndexBufferOffset != RHS.IndexBufferOffset
3575 || LHS.IndexBufferStride != RHS.IndexBufferStride
3576 || LHS.GeometryType != RHS.GeometryType
3577 || LHS.TotalPrimitiveCount != RHS.TotalPrimitiveCount)
3578 {
3579 return false;
3580 }
3581
3582 // Can't compare Segments directly due to some members not having equality operators
3583 if (LHS.Segments.Num() != RHS.Segments.Num())
3584 {
3585 return false;
3586 }
3587
3588 for (int32 SegmentIndex = 0; SegmentIndex < LHS.Segments.Num(); ++SegmentIndex)
3589 {
3590 //if (LHS.Segments[SegmentIndex] != RHS.Segments[SegmentIndex])
3591 //{
3592 // return false;
3593 //}
3594
3595 if (LHS.Segments[SegmentIndex].VertexBuffer != RHS.Segments[SegmentIndex].VertexBuffer
3596 || LHS.Segments[SegmentIndex].VertexBufferElementType != RHS.Segments[SegmentIndex].VertexBufferElementType
3597 || LHS.Segments[SegmentIndex].VertexBufferOffset != RHS.Segments[SegmentIndex].VertexBufferOffset
3598 || LHS.Segments[SegmentIndex].VertexBufferStride != RHS.Segments[SegmentIndex].VertexBufferStride
3599 || LHS.Segments[SegmentIndex].MaxVertices != RHS.Segments[SegmentIndex].MaxVertices
3600 || LHS.Segments[SegmentIndex].FirstPrimitive != RHS.Segments[SegmentIndex].FirstPrimitive
3601 || LHS.Segments[SegmentIndex].NumPrimitives != RHS.Segments[SegmentIndex].NumPrimitives
3602 || LHS.Segments[SegmentIndex].bForceOpaque != RHS.Segments[SegmentIndex].bForceOpaque
3603 || LHS.Segments[SegmentIndex].bAllowDuplicateAnyHitShaderInvocation != RHS.Segments[SegmentIndex].bAllowDuplicateAnyHitShaderInvocation
3604 || LHS.Segments[SegmentIndex].bEnabled != RHS.Segments[SegmentIndex].bEnabled)
3605 {
3606 return false;
3607 }
3608 }
3609
3610 if (LHS.OfflineData != RHS.OfflineData
3611 || LHS.SourceGeometry != RHS.SourceGeometry
3612 || LHS.bFastBuild != RHS.bFastBuild
3613 || LHS.bAllowUpdate != RHS.bAllowUpdate
3614 || LHS.bAllowCompaction != RHS.bAllowCompaction
3615 || LHS.Type != RHS.Type)
3616 {
3617 return false;
3618 }
3619
3620 // Can't compare DebugName directly due to FDebugName not having equality operator
3621 if (LHS.OwnerName != RHS.OwnerName)
3622 {
3623 return false;
3624 }
3625
3626 return true;
3627}
3628#endif

3672struct FRayTracingShaderBindingTableInitializer
3673{
3674 // Defines lifetime of the shader binding table
3675 ERayTracingShaderBindingTableLifetime Lifetime = ERayTracingShaderBindingTableLifetime::Transient;
3676
3677 // Defines which types of binding data needs to be stored in the SBT (Inline and/or RTPSO)
3678 ERayTracingShaderBindingMode ShaderBindingMode = ERayTracingShaderBindingMode::Disabled;
3679
3680 // Allow indexing of the hit group shaders for RTPSO bindings - if disabled then the SBT won't store any hit group data
3681 ERayTracingHitGroupIndexingMode HitGroupIndexingMode = ERayTracingHitGroupIndexingMode::Allow;
3682
3683 // Local binding data size used for each entry in the SBT (needs to be at least as big as the local binding data size of all shaders used in the SBT)
3684 uint32 LocalBindingDataSize = 0;
3685
3686 // This value controls how many elements will be allocated in the shader binding table per geometry segment.
3687 // Changing this value allows different hit shaders to be used for different effects.
3688 // For example, setting this to 2 allows one hit shader for regular material evaluation and a different one for shadows.
3689 // Desired hit shader can be selected by providing appropriate RayContributionToHitGroupIndex to TraceRay() function.
3690 // Use ShaderSlot argument in SetRayTracingHitGroup() to assign shaders and resources for specific part of the shder binding table record.
3691 uint32 NumShaderSlotsPerGeometrySegment = 1;
3692
3693 // Maximum number of geometry segments which can be stored in the hit group binding data
3694 uint32 NumGeometrySegments = 0;
3695
3696 // At least one miss shader must be present in a ray tracing scene.
3697 // Default miss shader is always in slot 0. Default shader must not use local resources.
3698 // Custom miss shaders can be bound to other slots using SetRayTracingMissShader().
3699 uint32 NumMissShaderSlots = 1;
3700
3701 // Defines how many different callable shaders with unique resource bindings can be bound to this scene.
3702 // Shaders and resources are assigned to slots in the scene using SetRayTracingCallableShader().
3703 uint32 NumCallableShaderSlots = 0;
3704};

3706struct FRayTracingSceneInitializer
3707{
3708 // Maximum number of instances in this scene. Actual number of instances is specified in FRayTracingSceneBuildParams.
3709 uint32 MaxNumInstances = 0;
3710
3711 UE_DEPRECATED(5.6, "Use FRayTracingShaderBindingTableInitializer instead.")

3844enum class ERayTracingClusterOperationType : uint8
3845{
3846 MOVE, // Moves CLAS, CLAS Templates, or Clustered BLAS
3847 CLAS_BUILD, // Builds CLAS from clusters of triangles
3848 CLAS_BUILD_TEMPLATES, // Builds CLAS templates from clusters of triangles
3849 CLAS_INSTANTIATE_TEMPLATES, // Instantiates CLAS templates
3850 BLAS_BUILD // Builds Clustered BLAS from CLAS
3851};
3852
3853enum class ERayTracingClusterOperationMoveType : uint8
3854{
3855 BOTTOM_LEVEL, // Moved objects are Clustered BLAS
3856 CLUSTER_LEVEL, // Moved objects are CLAS
3857 TEMPLATE // Moved objects are CLAS Templates
3858};
3859
3860enum class ERayTracingClusterOperationMode : uint8
3861{
3862 IMPLICIT_DESTINATIONS, // Provide total buffer space, driver places results within, returns VAs and actual sizes
3863 EXPLICIT_DESTINATIONS, // Provide individual target VAs, driver places them there, returns actual sizes
3864 GET_SIZES // Get minimum size per element
3865};
3866
3867enum class ERayTracingClusterOperationFlags : uint8
3868{
3869 NONE = 0x0,
3870 FAST_TRACE = 0x1,
3871 FAST_BUILD = 0x2,
3872 NO_OVERLAP = 0x4,
3873 ALLOW_OMM = 0x8
3874};
3875ENUM_CLASS_FLAGS(ERayTracingClusterOperationFlags);

3877struct FRayTracingClusterOperationMoveInitializer
3878{
3879 ERayTracingClusterOperationMoveType Type;
3880 uint32 MaxBytes = 0;
3881};
3882
3883struct FRayTracingClusterOperationCLASInitializer
3884{
3885 // Format of the CLAS vertices
3886 EVertexElementType VertexFormat = VET_Float3;
3887
3888 // Index of the last geometry in a single CLAS
3889 uint32 MaxGeometryIndex = 0;
3890
3891 // Maximum number of unique geometries in a single CLAS
3892 uint32 MaxUniqueGeometryCount = 1;
3893
3894 // Maximum number of triangles in a single CLAS
3895 uint32 MaxTriangleCount = 0;
3896
3897 // Maximum number of vertices in a single CLAS
3898 uint32 MaxVertexCount = 0;
3899
3900 // Maximum number of triangles across all CLAS (of the current cluster operation)
3901 uint32 MaxTotalTriangleCount = 0;
3902
3903 // Maximum number of vertices across all CLAS (of the current cluster operation)
3904 uint32 MaxTotalVertexCount = 0;
3905
3906 // Minimum number of bits to be truncated in vertex positions across all CLAS (in the current cluster operation)
3907 uint32 MinPositionTruncateBitCount = 0;
3908};
3909
3910struct FRayTracingClusterOperationBLASInitializer
3911{
3912 // Maximum number of CLAS referenced by a single BLAS

3914
3915 // Maximum number of CLAS references across all BLAS (in the current cluster operation)
3916 uint32 MaxTotalCLASCount = 0;
3917};
3918
3919struct FRayTracingClusterOperationInitializer
3920{
3921 // Maximum number of acceleration structures (or templates) to build/instantiate/move
3922 uint32 MaxResultCount = 0;
3923
3924 ERayTracingClusterOperationType Type;
3925 ERayTracingClusterOperationMode Mode;
3926 ERayTracingClusterOperationFlags Flags;
3927
3928 union
3929 {
3930 FRayTracingClusterOperationMoveInitializer Move;

3932 FRayTracingClusterOperationBLASInitializer BLAS;
3933 } Operation;

3990class FRHIShaderBundle : public FRHIResource

3992public:

3998public:
3999 FRHIShaderBundle() = delete;
4000 FRHIShaderBundle(const FShaderBundleCreateInfo& CreateInfo)
4001 : FRHIResource(RRT_ShaderBundle)
4002 , NumRecords(CreateInfo.NumRecords)
4003 , ArgOffset(CreateInfo.ArgOffset)
4004 , ArgStride(CreateInfo.ArgStride)
4005 , Mode(CreateInfo.Mode)
4006 {
4007#if DO_CHECK
4008 if (Mode == ERHIShaderBundleMode::CS)
4009 {

4012 }
4013 else if (Mode == ERHIShaderBundleMode::MSPS)
4014 {
4015 // Load
4016 check(ArgStride >= 4u);
4017 }
4018 else if (Mode == ERHIShaderBundleMode::VSPS)
4019 {
4020 // Load4
4021 check(ArgStride >= 16u);
4022 }
4023 else
4024 {
4025 checkNoEntry();
4026 }
4027#endif
4028 }

4030 const TCHAR* GetModeName() const
4031 {
4032 switch (Mode)
4033 {
4034 case ERHIShaderBundleMode::CS:
4035 return TEXT("CS");
4036 case ERHIShaderBundleMode::MSPS:
4037 return TEXT("MSPS");
4038 case ERHIShaderBundleMode::VSPS:
4039 return TEXT("VSPS");
4040 break;
4041 case ERHIShaderBundleMode::MAX:
4042 default:
4043 checkNoEntry();
4044 return TEXT("<none>");
4045 }
4046 }

4144class FRHIDepthRenderTargetView
4145{
4146public:

4151 ERenderTargetLoadAction StencilLoadAction;
4152
4153private:
4154 ERenderTargetStoreAction StencilStoreAction;
4155 FExclusiveDepthStencil DepthStencilAccess;
4156public:
4157
4158 // accessor to prevent write access to StencilStoreAction
4159 ERenderTargetStoreAction GetStencilStoreAction() const { return StencilStoreAction; }
4160 // accessor to prevent write access to DepthStencilAccess

4162

4164 Texture(nullptr),
4165 DepthLoadAction(ERenderTargetLoadAction::ENoAction),
4166 DepthStoreAction(ERenderTargetStoreAction::ENoAction),
4167 StencilLoadAction(ERenderTargetLoadAction::ENoAction),
4168 StencilStoreAction(ERenderTargetStoreAction::ENoAction),
4169 DepthStencilAccess(FExclusiveDepthStencil::DepthNop_StencilNop)
4170 {
4171 Validate();
4172 }
4173
4174 //common case
4175 explicit FRHIDepthRenderTargetView(FRHITexture* InTexture, ERenderTargetLoadAction InLoadAction, ERenderTargetStoreAction InStoreAction) :
4176 Texture(InTexture),
4177 DepthLoadAction(InLoadAction),
4178 DepthStoreAction(InStoreAction),
4179 StencilLoadAction(InLoadAction),
4180 StencilStoreAction(InStoreAction),
4181 DepthStencilAccess(FExclusiveDepthStencil::DepthWrite_StencilWrite)
4182 {
4183 Validate();
4184 }
4185
4186 explicit FRHIDepthRenderTargetView(FRHITexture* InTexture, ERenderTargetLoadAction InLoadAction, ERenderTargetStoreAction InStoreAction, FExclusiveDepthStencil InDepthStencilAccess) :
4187 Texture(InTexture),
4188 DepthLoadAction(InLoadAction),
4189 DepthStoreAction(InStoreAction),
4190 StencilLoadAction(InLoadAction),
4191 StencilStoreAction(InStoreAction),
4192 DepthStencilAccess(InDepthStencilAccess)
4193 {
4194 Validate();
4195 }
4196
4197 explicit FRHIDepthRenderTargetView(FRHITexture* InTexture, ERenderTargetLoadAction InDepthLoadAction, ERenderTargetStoreAction InDepthStoreAction, ERenderTargetLoadAction InStencilLoadAction, ERenderTargetStoreAction InStencilStoreAction) :
4198 Texture(InTexture),
4199 DepthLoadAction(InDepthLoadAction),
4200 DepthStoreAction(InDepthStoreAction),
4201 StencilLoadAction(InStencilLoadAction),
4202 StencilStoreAction(InStencilStoreAction),
4203 DepthStencilAccess(FExclusiveDepthStencil::DepthWrite_StencilWrite)
4204 {
4205 Validate();
4206 }
4207
4208 explicit FRHIDepthRenderTargetView(FRHITexture* InTexture, ERenderTargetLoadAction InDepthLoadAction, ERenderTargetStoreAction InDepthStoreAction, ERenderTargetLoadAction InStencilLoadAction, ERenderTargetStoreAction InStencilStoreAction, FExclusiveDepthStencil InDepthStencilAccess) :
4209 Texture(InTexture),
4210 DepthLoadAction(InDepthLoadAction),
4211 DepthStoreAction(InDepthStoreAction),
4212 StencilLoadAction(InStencilLoadAction),
4213 StencilStoreAction(InStencilStoreAction),
4214 DepthStencilAccess(InDepthStencilAccess)
4215 {
4216 Validate();
4217 }
4218
4219 void Validate() const
4220 {
4221 // VK and Metal MAY leave the attachment in an undefined state if the StoreAction is DontCare. So we can't assume read-only implies it should be DontCare unless we know for sure it will never be used again.
4222 // ensureMsgf(DepthStencilAccess.IsDepthWrite() || DepthStoreAction == ERenderTargetStoreAction::ENoAction, TEXT("Depth is read-only, but we are performing a store. This is a waste on mobile. If depth can't change, we don't need to store it out again"));
4223 /*ensureMsgf(DepthStencilAccess.IsStencilWrite() || StencilStoreAction == ERenderTargetStoreAction::ENoAction, TEXT("Stencil is read-only, but we are performing a store. This is a waste on mobile. If stencil can't change, we don't need to store it out again"));*/
4224 }
4225
4226 bool operator==(const FRHIDepthRenderTargetView& Other) const
4227 {
4228 return
4229 Texture == Other.Texture &&
4230 DepthLoadAction == Other.DepthLoadAction &&
4231 DepthStoreAction == Other.DepthStoreAction &&
4232 StencilLoadAction == Other.StencilLoadAction &&
4233 StencilStoreAction == Other.StencilStoreAction &&
4234 DepthStencilAccess == Other.DepthStencilAccess;
4235 }
4236};

4238class FRHISetRenderTargetsInfo
4239{
4240public:
4241 // Color Render Targets Info
4242 FRHIRenderTargetView ColorRenderTarget[MaxSimultaneousRenderTargets];
4243 int32 NumColorRenderTargets;
4244 bool bClearColor;
4245
4246 // Color Render Targets Info
4247 FRHIRenderTargetView ColorResolveRenderTarget[MaxSimultaneousRenderTargets];
4248 bool bHasResolveAttachments;
4249
4250 // Depth/Stencil Render Target Info
4251 FRHIDepthRenderTargetView DepthStencilRenderTarget;
4252 // Used when depth resolve is enabled.
4253 FRHIDepthRenderTargetView DepthStencilResolveRenderTarget;
4254 bool bClearDepth;
4255 bool bClearStencil;
4256
4257 FRHITexture* ShadingRateTexture;
4258 EVRSRateCombiner ShadingRateTextureCombiner;
4259
4260 uint8 MultiViewCount;
4261
4262 FRHISetRenderTargetsInfo() :
4263 NumColorRenderTargets(0),
4264 bClearColor(false),
4265 bHasResolveAttachments(false),
4266 bClearDepth(false),
4267 ShadingRateTexture(nullptr),
4268 MultiViewCount(0)
4269 {}
4270
4271 FRHISetRenderTargetsInfo(int32 InNumColorRenderTargets, const FRHIRenderTargetView* InColorRenderTargets, const FRHIDepthRenderTargetView& InDepthStencilRenderTarget) :
4272 NumColorRenderTargets(InNumColorRenderTargets),
4273 bClearColor(InNumColorRenderTargets > 0 && InColorRenderTargets[0].LoadAction == ERenderTargetLoadAction::EClear),
4274 bHasResolveAttachments(false),
4275 DepthStencilRenderTarget(InDepthStencilRenderTarget),
4276 bClearDepth(InDepthStencilRenderTarget.Texture && InDepthStencilRenderTarget.DepthLoadAction == ERenderTargetLoadAction::EClear),
4277 ShadingRateTexture(nullptr),
4278 ShadingRateTextureCombiner(VRSRB_Passthrough)
4279 {
4280 check(InNumColorRenderTargets <= 0 || InColorRenderTargets);
4281 for (int32 Index = 0; Index < InNumColorRenderTargets; ++Index)
4282 {
4283 ColorRenderTarget[Index] = InColorRenderTargets[Index];
4284 }
4285 }
4286 // @todo metal mrt: This can go away after all the cleanup is done
4287 void SetClearDepthStencil(bool bInClearDepth, bool bInClearStencil = false)
4288 {
4289 if (bInClearDepth)
4290 {
4291 DepthStencilRenderTarget.DepthLoadAction = ERenderTargetLoadAction::EClear;
4292 }
4293 if (bInClearStencil)
4294 {
4295 DepthStencilRenderTarget.StencilLoadAction = ERenderTargetLoadAction::EClear;
4296 }
4297 bClearDepth = bInClearDepth;
4298 bClearStencil = bInClearStencil;
4299 }
4300
4301 uint32 CalculateHash() const
4302 {
4303 // Need a separate struct so we can memzero/remove dependencies on reference counts
4304 struct FHashableStruct
4305 {
4306 // *2 for color and resolves
4307 // depth goes in the third-to-last slot
4308 // depth resolve goes in the second-to-last slot
4309 // shading rate goes in the last slot
4310 FRHITexture* Texture[MaxSimultaneousRenderTargets*2 + 3];
4311 uint32 MipIndex[MaxSimultaneousRenderTargets];
4312 uint32 ArraySliceIndex[MaxSimultaneousRenderTargets];
4313 ERenderTargetLoadAction LoadAction[MaxSimultaneousRenderTargets];
4314 ERenderTargetStoreAction StoreAction[MaxSimultaneousRenderTargets];
4315
4316 ERenderTargetLoadAction DepthLoadAction;
4317 ERenderTargetStoreAction DepthStoreAction;
4318 ERenderTargetLoadAction StencilLoadAction;
4319 ERenderTargetStoreAction StencilStoreAction;
4320 FExclusiveDepthStencil DepthStencilAccess;
4321
4322 bool bClearDepth;
4323 bool bClearStencil;
4324 bool bClearColor;
4325 bool bHasResolveAttachments;
4326 uint8 MultiViewCount;
4327
4328 void Set(const FRHISetRenderTargetsInfo& RTInfo)
4329 {
4330 FMemory::Memzero(*this);
4331 for (int32 Index = 0; Index < RTInfo.NumColorRenderTargets; ++Index)
4332 {
4333 Texture[Index] = RTInfo.ColorRenderTarget[Index].Texture;
4334 Texture[MaxSimultaneousRenderTargets+Index] = RTInfo.ColorResolveRenderTarget[Index].Texture;
4335 MipIndex[Index] = RTInfo.ColorRenderTarget[Index].MipIndex;
4336 ArraySliceIndex[Index] = RTInfo.ColorRenderTarget[Index].ArraySliceIndex;
4337 LoadAction[Index] = RTInfo.ColorRenderTarget[Index].LoadAction;
4338 StoreAction[Index] = RTInfo.ColorRenderTarget[Index].StoreAction;
4339 }
4340
4341 Texture[MaxSimultaneousRenderTargets*2] = RTInfo.DepthStencilRenderTarget.Texture;
4342 Texture[MaxSimultaneousRenderTargets*2 + 1] = RTInfo.DepthStencilResolveRenderTarget.Texture;
4343 Texture[MaxSimultaneousRenderTargets*2 + 2] = RTInfo.ShadingRateTexture;
4344 DepthLoadAction = RTInfo.DepthStencilRenderTarget.DepthLoadAction;
4345 DepthStoreAction = RTInfo.DepthStencilRenderTarget.DepthStoreAction;
4346 StencilLoadAction = RTInfo.DepthStencilRenderTarget.StencilLoadAction;
4347 StencilStoreAction = RTInfo.DepthStencilRenderTarget.GetStencilStoreAction();
4348 DepthStencilAccess = RTInfo.DepthStencilRenderTarget.GetDepthStencilAccess();
4349
4350 bClearDepth = RTInfo.bClearDepth;
4351 bClearStencil = RTInfo.bClearStencil;
4352 bClearColor = RTInfo.bClearColor;
4353 bHasResolveAttachments = RTInfo.bHasResolveAttachments;
4354 MultiViewCount = RTInfo.MultiViewCount;
4355 }
4356 };
4357
4358 FHashableStruct RTHash;
4359 FMemory::Memzero(RTHash);
4360 RTHash.Set(*this);
4361 return FCrc::MemCrc32(&RTHash, sizeof(RTHash));
4362 }
4363};
4364
4365class FRHICustomPresent : public FRHIResource
4366{
4367public:

4377 // match value subsequently returned by Present for this frame.
4378 virtual bool NeedsNativePresent() = 0;
4379 // In come cases we want to use custom present but still let the native environment handle
4380 // advancement of the backbuffer indices.
4381 // @return true if backbuffer index should advance independently from CustomPresent.
4382 virtual bool NeedsAdvanceBackbuffer() { return false; };
4383
4384 // Called from RHI thread when the engine begins drawing to the viewport.
4385 UE_DEPRECATED(5.7, "FRHICustomPresent::BeginDrawing is deprecated and never called.")
4386 virtual void BeginDrawing() {};
4387
4388 // Called from RHI thread to perform custom present.
4389 // @param InOutSyncInterval - in out param, indicates if vsync is on (>0) or off (==0).
4390 // @param RHICmdContext - the current rhi command context
4391 // @return true if native Present should be also be performed; false otherwise. If it returns
4392 // true, then InOutSyncInterval could be modified to switch between VSync/NoVSync for the normal
4393 // Present. Must match value previously returned by NeedsNativePresent for this frame.
4394 virtual bool Present(FRHIViewport* Viewport, IRHICommandContext& RHICmdContext, int32& InOutSyncInterval) { check(false); return true; };
4395
4396 // Called from Submission thread to perform custom present.
4397 // @param InOutSyncInterval - in out param, indicates if vsync is on (>0) or off (==0).
4398 // @return true if native Present should be also be performed; false otherwise. If it returns
4399 // true, then InOutSyncInterval could be modified to switch between VSync/NoVSync for the normal
4400 // Present. Must match value previously returned by NeedsNativePresent for this frame.
4401 virtual bool PresentOnSubmissionThread(int32& InOutSyncInterval) { check(false); return true; };
4402
4403 // Called after native Present has been called
4404 virtual void PostPresent() {};
4405
4406 // Called when rendering thread is acquired
4407 virtual void OnAcquireThreadOwnership() {}
4408 // Called when rendering thread is released
4409 virtual void OnReleaseThreadOwnership() {}
4410};

4474 void AddRefResources()
4475 {
4476 if (GetMeshShader())
4477 {
4478 check(VertexDeclarationRHI == nullptr);
4479 check(VertexShaderRHI == nullptr);
4480 check(GetWorkGraphShader() == nullptr);
4481 GetMeshShader()->AddRef();
4482
4483 if (GetAmplificationShader())
4484 {
4485 GetAmplificationShader()->AddRef();
4486 }
4487 }
4488 else if (GetWorkGraphShader())
4489 {
4490 check(VertexDeclarationRHI == nullptr);
4491 check(VertexShaderRHI == nullptr);
4492 check(GetMeshShader() == nullptr);
4493 GetWorkGraphShader()->AddRef();
4494 }
4495 else
4496 {
4497 check(VertexDeclarationRHI);
4498 VertexDeclarationRHI->AddRef();
4499
4500 check(VertexShaderRHI);
4501 VertexShaderRHI->AddRef();
4502 }
4503
4504 if (PixelShaderRHI)
4505 {
4506 PixelShaderRHI->AddRef();
4507 }
4508
4509 if (GetGeometryShader())
4510 {
4511 GetGeometryShader()->AddRef();
4512 }
4513 }
4514
4515 void ReleaseResources()
4516 {
4517 if (GetMeshShader())
4518 {
4519 check(VertexDeclarationRHI == nullptr);
4520 check(VertexShaderRHI == nullptr);
4521 check(GetWorkGraphShader() == nullptr);
4522 GetMeshShader()->Release();
4523
4524 if (GetAmplificationShader())
4525 {
4526 GetAmplificationShader()->Release();
4527 }
4528 }
4529 else if (GetWorkGraphShader())
4530 {
4531 check(VertexDeclarationRHI == nullptr);
4532 check(VertexShaderRHI == nullptr);
4533 check(GetMeshShader() == nullptr);
4534 GetWorkGraphShader()->Release();
4535 }
4536 else
4537 {
4538 check(VertexDeclarationRHI);
4539 VertexDeclarationRHI->Release();
4540
4541 check(VertexShaderRHI);
4542 VertexShaderRHI->Release();
4543 }
4544
4545 if (PixelShaderRHI)
4546 {
4547 PixelShaderRHI->Release();
4548 }
4549
4550 if (GetGeometryShader())
4551 {
4552 GetGeometryShader()->Release();
4553 }
4554 }

4748 bool operator==(const FGraphicsPipelineStateInitializer& rhs) const
4749 {
4750 if (BoundShaderState.VertexDeclarationRHI != rhs.BoundShaderState.VertexDeclarationRHI ||
4751 BoundShaderState.VertexShaderRHI != rhs.BoundShaderState.VertexShaderRHI ||
4752 BoundShaderState.PixelShaderRHI != rhs.BoundShaderState.PixelShaderRHI ||
4753 BoundShaderState.GetMeshShader() != rhs.BoundShaderState.GetMeshShader() ||
4754 BoundShaderState.GetAmplificationShader() != rhs.BoundShaderState.GetAmplificationShader() ||
4755 BoundShaderState.GetWorkGraphShader() != rhs.BoundShaderState.GetWorkGraphShader() ||
4756 BoundShaderState.GetGeometryShader() != rhs.BoundShaderState.GetGeometryShader() ||
4757 BlendState != rhs.BlendState ||
4758 RasterizerState != rhs.RasterizerState ||
4759 DepthStencilState != rhs.DepthStencilState ||
4760 PrimitiveType != rhs.PrimitiveType ||
4761 bDepthBounds != rhs.bDepthBounds ||
4762 MultiViewCount != rhs.MultiViewCount ||
4763 ShadingRate != rhs.ShadingRate ||
4764 bAllowVariableRateShading != rhs.bAllowVariableRateShading ||
4765 bHasFragmentDensityAttachment != rhs.bHasFragmentDensityAttachment ||
4766 RenderTargetsEnabled != rhs.RenderTargetsEnabled ||
4767 RenderTargetFormats != rhs.RenderTargetFormats ||
4768 !RelevantRenderTargetFlagsEqual(RenderTargetFlags, rhs.RenderTargetFlags) ||
4769 DepthStencilTargetFormat != rhs.DepthStencilTargetFormat ||
4770 !RelevantDepthStencilFlagsEqual(DepthStencilTargetFlag, rhs.DepthStencilTargetFlag) ||
4771 DepthTargetLoadAction != rhs.DepthTargetLoadAction ||
4772 DepthTargetStoreAction != rhs.DepthTargetStoreAction ||
4773 StencilTargetLoadAction != rhs.StencilTargetLoadAction ||
4774 StencilTargetStoreAction != rhs.StencilTargetStoreAction ||
4775 DepthStencilAccess != rhs.DepthStencilAccess ||
4776 NumSamples != rhs.NumSamples ||
4777 SubpassHint != rhs.SubpassHint ||
4778 SubpassIndex != rhs.SubpassIndex ||
4779 ConservativeRasterization != rhs.ConservativeRasterization)
4780 {
4781 return false;
4782 }
4783
4784 return true;
4785 }
4786
4787 // We care about flags that influence RT formats (which is the only thing the underlying API cares about).
4788 // In most RHIs, the format is only influenced by TexCreate_SRGB. D3D12 additionally uses TexCreate_Shared in its format selection logic.
4789 static constexpr ETextureCreateFlags RelevantRenderTargetFlagMask = ETextureCreateFlags::SRGB | ETextureCreateFlags::Shared;
4790
4791 // We care about flags that influence DS formats (which is the only thing the underlying API cares about).
4792 // D3D12 shares the format choice function with the RT, so preserving all the flags used there out of abundance of caution.
4793 static constexpr ETextureCreateFlags RelevantDepthStencilFlagMask = ETextureCreateFlags::SRGB | ETextureCreateFlags::Shared | ETextureCreateFlags::DepthStencilTargetable;
4794
4795 static bool RelevantRenderTargetFlagsEqual(const TRenderTargetFlags& A, const TRenderTargetFlags& B)
4796 {
4797 for (int32 Index = 0; Index < A.Num(); ++Index)
4798 {
4799 ETextureCreateFlags FlagsA = A[Index] & RelevantRenderTargetFlagMask;
4800 ETextureCreateFlags FlagsB = B[Index] & RelevantRenderTargetFlagMask;
4801 if (FlagsA != FlagsB)
4802 {
4803 return false;
4804 }
4805 }
4806 return true;
4807 }
4808
4809 static bool RelevantDepthStencilFlagsEqual(const ETextureCreateFlags A, const ETextureCreateFlags B)
4810 {
4811 ETextureCreateFlags FlagsA = (A & RelevantDepthStencilFlagMask);
4812 ETextureCreateFlags FlagsB = (B & RelevantDepthStencilFlagMask);
4813 return (FlagsA == FlagsB);
4814 }
4815
4816 uint32 ComputeNumValidRenderTargets() const
4817 {
4818 // Get the count of valid render targets (ignore those at the end of the array with PF_Unknown)
4819 if (RenderTargetsEnabled > 0)
4820 {
4821 int32 LastValidTarget = -1;
4822 for (int32 i = (int32)RenderTargetsEnabled - 1; i >= 0; i--)
4823 {
4824 if (RenderTargetFormats[i] != PF_Unknown)
4825 {
4826 LastValidTarget = i;
4827 break;
4828 }
4829 }
4830 return uint32(LastValidTarget + 1);
4831 }
4832 return RenderTargetsEnabled;
4833 }

4848 ERenderTargetLoadAction StencilTargetLoadAction;

4861 // Note: these flags do NOT affect compilation of this PSO.
4862 // The resulting object is invariant with respect to whatever is set here, they are
4863 // behavior hints.
4864 // They do not participate in equality comparisons or hashing.
4865 union
4866 {
4867 struct
4868 {
4869 uint16 Reserved : 11;
4870 uint16 bPSOPrecache : 1;
4871 uint16 bFromPSOFileCache : 1;
4872 uint16 PrecacheCompileType : 3;
4873 };

4876
4877 enum class EPSOPrecacheCompileType : uint8
4878 {
4879 NotSet = 0,
4880 MinPri = 1,
4881 NormalPri = 2,
4882 MaxPri = 3,
4883
4884 NumTypes = 4,
4885 };
4886 static_assert((int)EPSOPrecacheCompileType::MaxPri < (1<<3) ); // ensure MaxPri fits within PrecacheCompileType
4887 void SetPSOPrecacheCompileType(EPSOPrecacheCompileType PrecacheCompileTypeIN)
4888 {
4889 check(PrecacheCompileTypeIN <= EPSOPrecacheCompileType::MaxPri && PrecacheCompileTypeIN >= EPSOPrecacheCompileType::MinPri);
4890 PrecacheCompileType = (uint16)PrecacheCompileTypeIN;
4891 }
4892 EPSOPrecacheCompileType GetPSOPrecacheCompileType() const { return (EPSOPrecacheCompileType)PrecacheCompileType; }
4893
4894 // Cached hash off all state data provided at creation time (Only contains hash of data which influences the PSO precaching for the current platform)
4895 // Created from hashing the state data instead of the pointers which are used during fast runtime cache checking and compares
4896 uint64 StatePrecachePSOHash;
4897};

4961template<typename TShaderType>
4962inline uint64 ComputeShaderTableHash(const TArrayView<TShaderType*>& ShaderTable, uint64 InitialHash = 5699878132332235837ull)
4963{
4964 uint64 CombinedHash = InitialHash;
4965 for (FRHIShader* ShaderRHI : ShaderTable)
4966 {
4967 uint64 ShaderHash = 0;
4968 if (ShaderRHI)
4969 {
4970 ShaderHash = ShaderRHI->GetHash().Hash;
4971 }
4972
4973 // 64 bit hash combination as per boost::hash_combine_impl
4974 CombinedHash ^= ShaderHash + 0x9e3779b9 + (CombinedHash << 6) + (CombinedHash >> 2);
4975 }
4976
4977 return CombinedHash;
4978}

4980class FWorkGraphPipelineStateSignature
4981{

4986 {

4994 {

4998 GetTypeHash(Initializer.GraphicsPSOTableHash);

5000
5001 uint64 GetNameHash() const { return NameHash; }

5003 uint64 GetShaderTableHash() const { return ShaderTableHash; }
5004 uint64 GetGraphicsPSOTableHash() const { return GraphicsPSOTableHash; }
5005
5006protected:

5009 uint64 ShaderTableHash = 0;
5010 uint64 GraphicsPSOTableHash = 0;

5013class FWorkGraphPipelineStateInitializer : public FWorkGraphPipelineStateSignature

5025 struct FNameMap
5026 {

5030
5031 FNameMap(FString const& InExportName, FString const& InNodeName)

5038 {

5041 };
5042
5043 void SetNameTable(const TArrayView<FNameMap> InNameMaps, uint64 Hash = 0)
5044 {

5047 }
5048
5049 void SetShaderTable(const TArrayView<FRHIWorkGraphShader*>& InShaders, int32 InRootShaderIndex = -1, uint64 Hash = 0)
5050 {

5053 // RootShaderIndex doesn't need adding to a hash because if used correctly it is an artifact of the shader table.
5054 // (Only one shader in the array can have a global root signature).
5055 RootShaderIndex = InRootShaderIndex;
5056 }
5057
5058 void SetGraphicsPSOTable(const TArrayView<FGraphicsPipelineStateInitializer const*>& InGraphicsPSOs, uint64 Hash = 0)
5059 {

5062 }
5063
5064 FString const& GetProgramName() const { return ProgramName; }

5066 int32 GetRootShaderIndex() const { return RootShaderIndex; }
5067 TArrayView<FRHIWorkGraphShader*> const& GetShaderTable() const { return ShaderTable; }
5068 TArrayView<FGraphicsPipelineStateInitializer const*> const& GetGraphicsPSOTable() const { return GraphicsPSOTable; }
5069
5070private:
5071 RHI_API uint64 ComputeGraphicsPSOTableHash(const TArrayView<FGraphicsPipelineStateInitializer const*>& InGraphicsPSOTable, uint64 InitialHash = 5699878132332235837ull);
5072
5073 FString ProgramName;
5074 TArray<FNameMap> NameMaps;
5075 int32 RootShaderIndex = -1;
5076 TArrayView<FRHIWorkGraphShader*> ShaderTable;
5077 TArrayView<FGraphicsPipelineStateInitializer const*> GraphicsPSOTable;
5078};
