5080class FRayTracingPipelineStateSignature
5081{
5082public:
5083
5084 uint32 MaxAttributeSizeInBytes = 8; // sizeof FRayTracingIntersectionAttributes declared in RayTracingCommon.ush
5085 uint32 MaxPayloadSizeInBytes = 24; // sizeof FDefaultPayload declared in RayTracingCommon.ush
5086
5087 // NOTE: GetTypeHash(const FRayTracingPipelineStateInitializer& Initializer) should also be updated when changing this function
5088 bool operator==(const FRayTracingPipelineStateSignature& rhs) const
5089 {
5090 return MaxAttributeSizeInBytes == rhs.MaxAttributeSizeInBytes
5091 && MaxPayloadSizeInBytes == rhs.MaxPayloadSizeInBytes
5092 && RayGenHash == rhs.RayGenHash
5093 && MissHash == rhs.MissHash
5094 && HitGroupHash == rhs.HitGroupHash
5095 && CallableHash == rhs.CallableHash;
5096 }
5097
5098 friend uint32 GetTypeHash(const FRayTracingPipelineStateSignature& Initializer)
5099 {
5100 return GetTypeHash(Initializer.MaxAttributeSizeInBytes) ^
5101 GetTypeHash(Initializer.MaxPayloadSizeInBytes) ^
5102 GetTypeHash(Initializer.GetRayGenHash()) ^
5103 GetTypeHash(Initializer.GetRayMissHash()) ^
5104 GetTypeHash(Initializer.GetHitGroupHash()) ^
5105 GetTypeHash(Initializer.GetCallableHash());
5106 }
5107
5108 uint64 GetHitGroupHash() const { return HitGroupHash; }
5109 uint64 GetRayGenHash() const { return RayGenHash; }
5110 uint64 GetRayMissHash() const { return MissHash; }
5111 uint64 GetCallableHash() const { return CallableHash; }
5112
5113protected:
5114
5115 uint64 RayGenHash = 0;
5116 uint64 MissHash = 0;
5117 uint64 HitGroupHash = 0;
5118 uint64 CallableHash = 0;
5119};
5120
5121class FRayTracingPipelineStateInitializer : public FRayTracingPipelineStateSignature
5122{
5123public:
5124
5125 FRayTracingPipelineStateInitializer() = default;
5126
5127 // Partial ray tracing pipelines can be used for run-time asynchronous shader compilation, but not for rendering.
5128 // Any number of shaders for any stage may be provided when creating partial pipelines, but
5129 // at least one shader must be present in total (completely empty pipelines are not allowed).
5130 bool bPartial = false;
5131
5132 // Hints to the RHI that this PSO is being compiled by a background task and will not be needed immediately for rendering.
5133 // Speculative PSO pre-caching or non-blocking PSO creation should set this flag.
5134 // This may be used by the RHI to decide if a hitch warning should be reported, change priority of any internally dispatched tasks, etc.
5135 // Does not affect the creation of the PSO itself.
5136 bool bBackgroundCompilation = false;
5137
5138 // Ray tracing pipeline may be created by deriving from the existing base.
5139 // Base pipeline will be extended by adding new shaders into it, potentially saving substantial amount of CPU time.
5140 // Depends on GRHISupportsRayTracingPSOAdditions support at runtime (base pipeline is simply ignored if it is unsupported).
5141 FRayTracingPipelineStateRHIRef BasePipeline;
5142
5143 // Shader binding table layout used during shader compilation which needs to be the same for all shaders in the RTPSO and defines
5144 // how uniform buffers needs to be bound at runtime (global(RayGen) vs local(miss/hit/callable) data)
5145 const FRHIShaderBindingLayout* ShaderBindingLayout = nullptr;
5146
5147 const TArrayView<FRHIRayTracingShader*>& GetRayGenTable() const { return RayGenTable; }
5148 const TArrayView<FRHIRayTracingShader*>& GetMissTable() const { return MissTable; }
5149 const TArrayView<FRHIRayTracingShader*>& GetHitGroupTable() const { return HitGroupTable; }
5150 const TArrayView<FRHIRayTracingShader*>& GetCallableTable() const { return CallableTable; }
5151
5152 // Shaders used as entry point to ray tracing work. At least one RayGen shader must be provided.
5153 void SetRayGenShaderTable(const TArrayView<FRHIRayTracingShader*>& InRayGenShaders, uint64 Hash = 0)
5154 {
5155 RayGenTable = InRayGenShaders;
5156 RayGenHash = Hash ? Hash : ComputeShaderTableHash(InRayGenShaders);
5157 }
5158
5159 // Shaders that will be invoked if a ray misses all geometry.
5160 // If this table is empty, then a built-in default miss shader will be used that sets HitT member of FMinimalPayload to -1.
5161 // Desired miss shader can be selected by providing MissShaderIndex to TraceRay() function.
5162 void SetMissShaderTable(const TArrayView<FRHIRayTracingShader*>& InMissShaders, uint64 Hash = 0)
5163 {
5164 MissTable = InMissShaders;
5165 MissHash = Hash ? Hash : ComputeShaderTableHash(InMissShaders);
5166 }
5167
5168 // Shaders that will be invoked when ray intersects geometry.
5169 // If this table is empty, then a built-in default shader will be used for all geometry, using FDefaultPayload.
5170 void SetHitGroupTable(const TArrayView<FRHIRayTracingShader*>& InHitGroups, uint64 Hash = 0)
5171 {
5172 HitGroupTable = InHitGroups;
5173 HitGroupHash = Hash ? Hash : ComputeShaderTableHash(HitGroupTable);
5174 }
5175
5176 // Shaders that can be explicitly invoked from RayGen shaders by their Shader Binding Table (SBT) index.
5177 // SetRayTracingCallableShader() command must be used to fill SBT slots before a shader can be called.
5178 void SetCallableTable(const TArrayView<FRHIRayTracingShader*>& InCallableShaders, uint64 Hash = 0)
5179 {
5180 CallableTable = InCallableShaders;
5181 CallableHash = Hash ? Hash : ComputeShaderTableHash(CallableTable);
5182 }
5183
5184 // Retrieve the max local binding size of all the raytracing shaders used in the RTPSO
5185 RHI_API uint32 GetMaxLocalBindingDataSize() const;
5186
5187private:
5188 TArrayView<FRHIRayTracingShader*> RayGenTable;
5189 TArrayView<FRHIRayTracingShader*> MissTable;
5190 TArrayView<FRHIRayTracingShader*> HitGroupTable;
5191 TArrayView<FRHIRayTracingShader*> CallableTable;
5192};

5194// This PSO is used as a fallback for RHIs that dont support PSOs. It is used to set the graphics state using the legacy state setting APIs

5206 {

5209 case SF_Vertex: return Initializer.BoundShaderState.GetVertexShader();
5210 case SF_Mesh: return Initializer.BoundShaderState.GetMeshShader();
5211 case SF_Amplification: return Initializer.BoundShaderState.GetAmplificationShader();
5212 case SF_Pixel: return Initializer.BoundShaderState.GetPixelShader();
5213 case SF_Geometry: return Initializer.BoundShaderState.GetGeometryShader();
5214 default: return nullptr;
5215 }
5216 }

5218 FGraphicsPipelineStateInitializer Initializer;
5219};

5307struct FResolveRect
5308{
5309 int32 X1;
5310 int32 Y1;
5311 int32 X2;
5312 int32 Y2;
5313
5314 // e.g. for a a full 256 x 256 area starting at (0, 0) it would be
5315 // the values would be 0, 0, 256, 256
5316 FResolveRect(int32 InX1 = -1, int32 InY1 = -1, int32 InX2 = -1, int32 InY2 = -1)
5317 : X1(InX1)
5318 , Y1(InY1)
5319 , X2(InX2)
5320 , Y2(InY2)
5321 {}
5322
5323 explicit FResolveRect(FIntRect Other)
5324 : X1(Other.Min.X)
5325 , Y1(Other.Min.Y)
5326 , X2(Other.Max.X)
5327 , Y2(Other.Max.Y)
5328 {}
5329
5330 bool operator==(FResolveRect Other) const
5331 {
5332 return X1 == Other.X1 && Y1 == Other.Y1 && X2 == Other.X2 && Y2 == Other.Y2;
5333 }
5334
5335 bool operator!=(FResolveRect Other) const
5336 {
5337 return !(*this == Other);
5338 }
5339
5340 bool IsValid() const
5341 {
5342 return X1 >= 0 && Y1 >= 0 && X2 - X1 > 0 && Y2 - Y1 > 0;
5343 }
5344};

5346struct FRHIRenderPassInfo
5347{
5348 struct FColorEntry
5349 {
5350 FRHITexture* RenderTarget = nullptr;
5351 FRHITexture* ResolveTarget = nullptr;
5352 int32 ArraySlice = -1;
5353 uint8 MipIndex = 0;
5354 ERenderTargetActions Action = ERenderTargetActions::DontLoad_DontStore;
5355 };
5356 TStaticArray<FColorEntry, MaxSimultaneousRenderTargets> ColorRenderTargets;
5357
5358 struct FDepthStencilEntry
5359 {
5360 FRHITexture* DepthStencilTarget = nullptr;
5361 FRHITexture* ResolveTarget = nullptr;
5362 EDepthStencilTargetActions Action = EDepthStencilTargetActions::DontLoad_DontStore;
5363 FExclusiveDepthStencil ExclusiveDepthStencil;
5364 };
5365 FDepthStencilEntry DepthStencilRenderTarget;
5366
5367 // Controls the area for a multisample resolve or raster UAV (i.e. no fixed-function targets) operation.
5368 FResolveRect ResolveRect;
5369
5370 // Some RHIs can use a texture to control the sampling and/or shading resolution of different areas
5371 FTextureRHIRef ShadingRateTexture = nullptr;
5372 EVRSRateCombiner ShadingRateTextureCombiner = VRSRB_Passthrough;
5373
5374 // Some RHIs need to know the layout of all planes in the depth target
5375 ERHIAccess NopAccess = ERHIAccess::Unknown;
5376
5377 // Some RHIs require a hint that occlusion queries will be used in this render pass
5378 uint32 NumOcclusionQueries = 0;
5379 bool bOcclusionQueries = false;
5380
5381 // if this renderpass should be multiview, and if so how many views are required
5382 uint8 MultiViewCount = 0;
5383
5384 // Hint for some RHI's that renderpass will have specific sub-passes
5385 ESubpassHint SubpassHint = ESubpassHint::None;
5386
5387 FRHIRenderPassInfo() = default;
5388 FRHIRenderPassInfo(const FRHIRenderPassInfo&) = default;
5389 FRHIRenderPassInfo& operator=(const FRHIRenderPassInfo&) = default;
5390
5391 // Color, no depth, optional resolve, optional mip, optional array slice
5392 explicit FRHIRenderPassInfo(FRHITexture* ColorRT, ERenderTargetActions ColorAction, FRHITexture* ResolveRT = nullptr, uint8 InMipIndex = 0, int32 InArraySlice = -1)
5393 {
5394 check(!(ResolveRT && ResolveRT->IsMultisampled()));
5395 check(ColorRT);
5396 ColorRenderTargets[0].RenderTarget = ColorRT;
5397 ColorRenderTargets[0].ResolveTarget = ResolveRT;
5398 ColorRenderTargets[0].ArraySlice = InArraySlice;
5399 ColorRenderTargets[0].MipIndex = InMipIndex;
5400 ColorRenderTargets[0].Action = ColorAction;
5401 }
5402
5403 // Color MRTs, no depth
5404 explicit FRHIRenderPassInfo(int32 NumColorRTs, FRHITexture* ColorRTs[], ERenderTargetActions ColorAction)
5405 {
5406 check(NumColorRTs > 0);
5407 for (int32 Index = 0; Index < NumColorRTs; ++Index)
5408 {
5409 check(ColorRTs[Index]);
5410 ColorRenderTargets[Index].RenderTarget = ColorRTs[Index];
5411 ColorRenderTargets[Index].ArraySlice = -1;
5412 ColorRenderTargets[Index].Action = ColorAction;
5413 }
5414 DepthStencilRenderTarget.DepthStencilTarget = nullptr;
5415 DepthStencilRenderTarget.Action = EDepthStencilTargetActions::DontLoad_DontStore;
5416 DepthStencilRenderTarget.ExclusiveDepthStencil = FExclusiveDepthStencil::DepthNop_StencilNop;
5417 DepthStencilRenderTarget.ResolveTarget = nullptr;
5418 }
5419
5420 // Color MRTs, no depth
5421 explicit FRHIRenderPassInfo(int32 NumColorRTs, FRHITexture* ColorRTs[], ERenderTargetActions ColorAction, FRHITexture* ResolveTargets[])
5422 {
5423 check(NumColorRTs > 0);
5424 for (int32 Index = 0; Index < NumColorRTs; ++Index)
5425 {
5426 check(ColorRTs[Index]);
5427 ColorRenderTargets[Index].RenderTarget = ColorRTs[Index];
5428 ColorRenderTargets[Index].ResolveTarget = ResolveTargets[Index];
5429 ColorRenderTargets[Index].ArraySlice = -1;
5430 ColorRenderTargets[Index].MipIndex = 0;
5431 ColorRenderTargets[Index].Action = ColorAction;
5432 }
5433 DepthStencilRenderTarget.DepthStencilTarget = nullptr;
5434 DepthStencilRenderTarget.Action = EDepthStencilTargetActions::DontLoad_DontStore;
5435 DepthStencilRenderTarget.ExclusiveDepthStencil = FExclusiveDepthStencil::DepthNop_StencilNop;
5436 DepthStencilRenderTarget.ResolveTarget = nullptr;
5437 }
5438
5439 // Color MRTs and depth
5440 explicit FRHIRenderPassInfo(int32 NumColorRTs, FRHITexture* ColorRTs[], ERenderTargetActions ColorAction, FRHITexture* DepthRT, EDepthStencilTargetActions DepthActions, FExclusiveDepthStencil InEDS = FExclusiveDepthStencil::DepthWrite_StencilWrite)
5441 {
5442 check(NumColorRTs > 0);
5443 for (int32 Index = 0; Index < NumColorRTs; ++Index)
5444 {
5445 check(ColorRTs[Index]);
5446 ColorRenderTargets[Index].RenderTarget = ColorRTs[Index];
5447 ColorRenderTargets[Index].ResolveTarget = nullptr;
5448 ColorRenderTargets[Index].ArraySlice = -1;
5449 ColorRenderTargets[Index].MipIndex = 0;
5450 ColorRenderTargets[Index].Action = ColorAction;
5451 }
5452 check(DepthRT);
5453 DepthStencilRenderTarget.DepthStencilTarget = DepthRT;
5454 DepthStencilRenderTarget.ResolveTarget = nullptr;
5455 DepthStencilRenderTarget.Action = DepthActions;
5456 DepthStencilRenderTarget.ExclusiveDepthStencil = InEDS;
5457 }
5458
5459 // Color MRTs and depth
5460 explicit FRHIRenderPassInfo(int32 NumColorRTs, FRHITexture* ColorRTs[], ERenderTargetActions ColorAction, FRHITexture* ResolveRTs[], FRHITexture* DepthRT, EDepthStencilTargetActions DepthActions, FRHITexture* ResolveDepthRT, FExclusiveDepthStencil InEDS = FExclusiveDepthStencil::DepthWrite_StencilWrite)
5461 {
5462 check(NumColorRTs > 0);
5463 for (int32 Index = 0; Index < NumColorRTs; ++Index)
5464 {
5465 check(!ResolveRTs[Index] || ResolveRTs[Index]->IsMultisampled());
5466 check(ColorRTs[Index]);
5467 ColorRenderTargets[Index].RenderTarget = ColorRTs[Index];
5468 ColorRenderTargets[Index].ResolveTarget = ResolveRTs[Index];
5469 ColorRenderTargets[Index].ArraySlice = -1;
5470 ColorRenderTargets[Index].MipIndex = 0;
5471 ColorRenderTargets[Index].Action = ColorAction;
5472 }
5473 check(!ResolveDepthRT || ResolveDepthRT->IsMultisampled());
5474 check(DepthRT);
5475 DepthStencilRenderTarget.DepthStencilTarget = DepthRT;
5476 DepthStencilRenderTarget.ResolveTarget = ResolveDepthRT;
5477 DepthStencilRenderTarget.Action = DepthActions;
5478 DepthStencilRenderTarget.ExclusiveDepthStencil = InEDS;
5479 }
5480
5481 // Depth, no color
5482 explicit FRHIRenderPassInfo(FRHITexture* DepthRT, EDepthStencilTargetActions DepthActions, FRHITexture* ResolveDepthRT = nullptr, FExclusiveDepthStencil InEDS = FExclusiveDepthStencil::DepthWrite_StencilWrite)
5483 {
5484 check(!ResolveDepthRT || ResolveDepthRT->IsMultisampled());
5485 check(DepthRT);
5486 DepthStencilRenderTarget.DepthStencilTarget = DepthRT;
5487 DepthStencilRenderTarget.ResolveTarget = ResolveDepthRT;
5488 DepthStencilRenderTarget.Action = DepthActions;
5489 DepthStencilRenderTarget.ExclusiveDepthStencil = InEDS;
5490 }
5491
5492 // Depth, no color, occlusion queries
5493 explicit FRHIRenderPassInfo(FRHITexture* DepthRT, uint32 InNumOcclusionQueries, EDepthStencilTargetActions DepthActions, FRHITexture* ResolveDepthRT = nullptr, FExclusiveDepthStencil InEDS = FExclusiveDepthStencil::DepthWrite_StencilWrite)
5494 : NumOcclusionQueries(InNumOcclusionQueries)
5495 {
5496 check(!ResolveDepthRT || ResolveDepthRT->IsMultisampled());
5497 check(DepthRT);
5498 DepthStencilRenderTarget.DepthStencilTarget = DepthRT;
5499 DepthStencilRenderTarget.ResolveTarget = ResolveDepthRT;
5500 DepthStencilRenderTarget.Action = DepthActions;
5501 DepthStencilRenderTarget.ExclusiveDepthStencil = InEDS;
5502 }
5503
5504 // Color and depth
5505 explicit FRHIRenderPassInfo(FRHITexture* ColorRT, ERenderTargetActions ColorAction, FRHITexture* DepthRT, EDepthStencilTargetActions DepthActions, FExclusiveDepthStencil InEDS = FExclusiveDepthStencil::DepthWrite_StencilWrite)
5506 {
5507 check(ColorRT);
5508 ColorRenderTargets[0].RenderTarget = ColorRT;
5509 ColorRenderTargets[0].ResolveTarget = nullptr;
5510 ColorRenderTargets[0].ArraySlice = -1;
5511 ColorRenderTargets[0].MipIndex = 0;
5512 ColorRenderTargets[0].Action = ColorAction;
5513 check(DepthRT);
5514 DepthStencilRenderTarget.DepthStencilTarget = DepthRT;
5515 DepthStencilRenderTarget.ResolveTarget = nullptr;
5516 DepthStencilRenderTarget.Action = DepthActions;
5517 DepthStencilRenderTarget.ExclusiveDepthStencil = InEDS;
5518 FMemory::Memzero(&ColorRenderTargets[1], sizeof(FColorEntry) * (MaxSimultaneousRenderTargets - 1));
5519 }
5520
5521 // Color and depth with resolve
5522 explicit FRHIRenderPassInfo(FRHITexture* ColorRT, ERenderTargetActions ColorAction, FRHITexture* ResolveColorRT,
5523 FRHITexture* DepthRT, EDepthStencilTargetActions DepthActions, FRHITexture* ResolveDepthRT, FExclusiveDepthStencil InEDS = FExclusiveDepthStencil::DepthWrite_StencilWrite)
5524 {
5525 check(!ResolveColorRT || ResolveColorRT->IsMultisampled());
5526 check(!ResolveDepthRT || ResolveDepthRT->IsMultisampled());
5527 check(ColorRT);
5528 ColorRenderTargets[0].RenderTarget = ColorRT;
5529 ColorRenderTargets[0].ResolveTarget = ResolveColorRT;
5530 ColorRenderTargets[0].ArraySlice = -1;
5531 ColorRenderTargets[0].MipIndex = 0;
5532 ColorRenderTargets[0].Action = ColorAction;
5533 check(DepthRT);
5534 DepthStencilRenderTarget.DepthStencilTarget = DepthRT;
5535 DepthStencilRenderTarget.ResolveTarget = ResolveDepthRT;
5536 DepthStencilRenderTarget.Action = DepthActions;
5537 DepthStencilRenderTarget.ExclusiveDepthStencil = InEDS;
5538 FMemory::Memzero(&ColorRenderTargets[1], sizeof(FColorEntry) * (MaxSimultaneousRenderTargets - 1));
5539 }
5540
5541 // Color and depth with resolve and optional sample density
5542 explicit FRHIRenderPassInfo(FRHITexture* ColorRT, ERenderTargetActions ColorAction, FRHITexture* ResolveColorRT,
5543 FRHITexture* DepthRT, EDepthStencilTargetActions DepthActions, FRHITexture* ResolveDepthRT,
5544 FRHITexture* InShadingRateTexture, EVRSRateCombiner InShadingRateTextureCombiner,
5545 FExclusiveDepthStencil InEDS = FExclusiveDepthStencil::DepthWrite_StencilWrite)
5546 {
5547 check(!ResolveColorRT || ResolveColorRT->IsMultisampled());
5548 check(!ResolveDepthRT || ResolveDepthRT->IsMultisampled());
5549 check(ColorRT);
5550 ColorRenderTargets[0].RenderTarget = ColorRT;
5551 ColorRenderTargets[0].ResolveTarget = ResolveColorRT;
5552 ColorRenderTargets[0].ArraySlice = -1;
5553 ColorRenderTargets[0].MipIndex = 0;
5554 ColorRenderTargets[0].Action = ColorAction;
5555 check(DepthRT);
5556 DepthStencilRenderTarget.DepthStencilTarget = DepthRT;
5557 DepthStencilRenderTarget.ResolveTarget = ResolveDepthRT;
5558 DepthStencilRenderTarget.Action = DepthActions;
5559 DepthStencilRenderTarget.ExclusiveDepthStencil = InEDS;
5560 ShadingRateTexture = InShadingRateTexture;
5561 ShadingRateTextureCombiner = InShadingRateTextureCombiner;
5562 FMemory::Memzero(&ColorRenderTargets[1], sizeof(FColorEntry) * (MaxSimultaneousRenderTargets - 1));
5563 }
5564
5565 inline int32 GetNumColorRenderTargets() const
5566 {
5567 int32 ColorIndex = 0;
5568 for (; ColorIndex < MaxSimultaneousRenderTargets; ++ColorIndex)
5569 {
5570 const FColorEntry& Entry = ColorRenderTargets[ColorIndex];
5571 if (!Entry.RenderTarget)
5572 {
5573 break;
5574 }
5575 }
5576
5577 return ColorIndex;
5578 }
5579
5580 FGraphicsPipelineRenderTargetsInfo ExtractRenderTargetsInfo() const
5581 {
5582 FGraphicsPipelineRenderTargetsInfo RenderTargetsInfo;
5583
5584 RenderTargetsInfo.NumSamples = 1;
5585 int32 RenderTargetIndex = 0;
5586
5587 for (; RenderTargetIndex < MaxSimultaneousRenderTargets; ++RenderTargetIndex)
5588 {
5589 FRHITexture* RenderTarget = ColorRenderTargets[RenderTargetIndex].RenderTarget;
5590 if (!RenderTarget)
5591 {
5592 break;
5593 }
5594
5595 RenderTargetsInfo.RenderTargetFormats[RenderTargetIndex] = (uint8)RenderTarget->GetFormat();
5596 RenderTargetsInfo.RenderTargetFlags[RenderTargetIndex] = RenderTarget->GetFlags();
5597 RenderTargetsInfo.NumSamples |= RenderTarget->GetNumSamples();
5598 }
5599
5600 RenderTargetsInfo.RenderTargetsEnabled = RenderTargetIndex;
5601 for (; RenderTargetIndex < MaxSimultaneousRenderTargets; ++RenderTargetIndex)
5602 {
5603 RenderTargetsInfo.RenderTargetFormats[RenderTargetIndex] = PF_Unknown;
5604 }
5605
5606 if (DepthStencilRenderTarget.DepthStencilTarget)
5607 {
5608 RenderTargetsInfo.DepthStencilTargetFormat = DepthStencilRenderTarget.DepthStencilTarget->GetFormat();
5609 RenderTargetsInfo.DepthStencilTargetFlag = DepthStencilRenderTarget.DepthStencilTarget->GetFlags();
5610 RenderTargetsInfo.NumSamples |= DepthStencilRenderTarget.DepthStencilTarget->GetNumSamples();
5611 }
5612 else
5613 {
5614 RenderTargetsInfo.DepthStencilTargetFormat = PF_Unknown;
5615 }
5616
5617 const ERenderTargetActions DepthActions = GetDepthActions(DepthStencilRenderTarget.Action);
5618 const ERenderTargetActions StencilActions = GetStencilActions(DepthStencilRenderTarget.Action);
5619 RenderTargetsInfo.DepthTargetLoadAction = GetLoadAction(DepthActions);
5620 RenderTargetsInfo.DepthTargetStoreAction = GetStoreAction(DepthActions);
5621 RenderTargetsInfo.StencilTargetLoadAction = GetLoadAction(StencilActions);
5622 RenderTargetsInfo.StencilTargetStoreAction = GetStoreAction(StencilActions);
5623 RenderTargetsInfo.DepthStencilAccess = DepthStencilRenderTarget.ExclusiveDepthStencil;
5624
5625 RenderTargetsInfo.MultiViewCount = MultiViewCount;
5626 RenderTargetsInfo.bHasFragmentDensityAttachment = ShadingRateTexture != nullptr;
5627
5628 return RenderTargetsInfo;
5629 }
5630
5631#if !(UE_BUILD_SHIPPING || UE_BUILD_TEST)
5632 RHI_API void Validate() const;
5633#else
5634 void Validate() const {}
5635#endif
5636 RHI_API void ConvertToRenderTargetsInfo(FRHISetRenderTargetsInfo& OutRTInfo) const;
5637};
